先生，

1940年7月9日下午2点，一名名为刘友山（Liu-You Sai），40岁，籍贯 Komro（音译），职业为妓院老板，居住在吴淞路同仁里289号的男子，被一名名为孙金元（Sung-Chung-Yue）的上海市警察局侦缉队员带至警局，孙持有 warrant card（委任证）第283号。前者系由后者在未经上海公共租界警务处知晓的情况下逮捕，逮捕行动于1940年7月9日下午1点50分在被告家中实施。

当在收押室核实逮捕细节时，日本海军陆战队乍浦路分署负责人、特别高级警佐萨西（Sassi）来到警局认领上述囚犯，他声称该囚犯是奉其命令由孙金元逮捕的，由于误会，孙将其带到了虹口分局，而他原本指示逮捕被告并将其带到乍浦路日本海军陆战队分署。

进一步调查显示，1940年7月4日凌晨3点左右，位于乍浦路的三菱公司（Mitsubishi Kaisha）仓库遭闯入，九箱中国茶叶被盗。

随后，上述当局获得了情报，侦缉员孙金元前往吴淞路的日本海军陆战队分署，向萨西警佐寻求并获得许可逮捕刘友山，情报显示他

Made by D.S.I. Loh Wei Kong Forwarded by D. I. Crawford

A sub-office of the Shang-Pao (Shanghai-
Paoshan) Aerated Water Tax Collection Office 上寶
區汽水稅稽征處 was recently established at
867 Robison Road, O.O.L., with one TSEU VUNG MING
(徐鳳鳴) in charge. It deals with the sale of
stamps and collection of tax on aerated water either
passing through or offered for sale in the extra-
Settlement roads area, Western District. Six
inspectors attached to the sub-office are functioning
in that area.

The collection is made according to the
trade marks. In respect of foreign products, each
pint-bottle of mineral water is required to have
affixed to it a tax stamp costing two cents, and
each half pint-bottle, a tax stamp costing one cent;
while for that of Chinese origin, each pint bottle
is required to have affixed to it a tax stamp
costing one cent, and half pint bottle, half cent.

According to the regulations governing
the collection of tax on aerated water, any person
who is found to have failed to pay tax will be
subject to a fine amounting to between five and
ten times the original rate, and/or the confiscation
of the product.

由副督察罗伟康（Loh Wei Kong，音译）撰写 由督察克劳福德（Crawford）转呈

上宝区汽水税稽征处的一个分处最近在西区罗宾森路（Robison Road，今南京西路）867号成立，由徐凤鸣（TSEU VUNG MING）负责。该分处处理在越界筑路区域、西区通行或待售的汽水的印花税票销售及税款征收工作。六名隶属于该分处的稽查员在该区域开展工作。

征税是根据商标进行的。对于外国产品，每品脱瓶矿泉水需张贴价值两分的税票，每半品脱瓶需张贴价值一分的税票；而对于中国产产品，每品脱瓶需张贴价值一分的税票，半品脱瓶需张贴价值半分（0.5分）的税票。

根据汽水征税规定，任何被发现未缴纳税款的人将被处以相当于原税率五至十倍的罚款，和/或没收产品。

本报告附有《江苏省汽水征税暂行条例》

Provisional Regulations Governing the Collection
of Tax on Aerated Water in Kiangsu Province.

Article 1:
These regulations are applicable to
either native or foreign aerated water.

Article 2:
Tax on the foreign and native aerated
water shall be collected in accordance
with the following rate :
(a) Foreign aerated water :
1 pint bottle - 2 cents each.
½ " " - 1 cent each.
(b) Native aerated water :
Large bottle - 1½ cents each.
(beer bottle)
1 pint bottle - 1 cent each.
½ " " - ½ " " .

Article 3:
The tax on aerated water shall be collected
by the Kiangsu Provincial Tobacco and Wine
Stamp Tax Bureau.

Article 4:
Stamps shall be issued by the Tax Collection
Offices concerned against the payment of tax
and that aerated water shall be permitted to
be offered for sale after the stamps have
been affixed on the bottles. Those who intend
to transport the aerated water shall apply
for transportation certificates.

Article 5:
The tax stamps and transportation certificates
for aerated water shall be prepared and
issued by the Kiangsu-Chekiang-Anhwei Revenue
Bureau.

江苏省汽水征税暂行条例。

第一条：
本条例适用于国产或进口汽水。

第二条：
进口和国产汽水的税收应按
以下税率征收：
(a) 进口汽水：
1品脱瓶 - 每瓶2分。
½ " " - 每瓶1分。
(b) 国产汽水：
大瓶 - 每瓶1.5分。
(啤酒瓶)
1品脱瓶 - 每瓶1分。
½ " " - 每瓶½分。

第三条：
汽水税由江苏省烟酒印花税局
征收。

第四条：
相关稽征处在缴纳税款后发放税票，
汽水瓶张贴税票后方可允许出售。
意图运输汽水者须申请运输证。

第五条：
汽水税票和运输证由
江苏-浙江-安徽税务局制备和
发放。

pages.en:
- 2 -

Article 6:
No further collection shall be made on the
aerated water for which a tax has been paid,
in the area under the jurisdiction of the
Kiangsu-Chekiang-Anhwei Revenue Bureau.

Article 7:
Procedure governing the transportation
and inspection of aerated water shall be
devised separately.

Article 8:
Those who fail to pay the necessary tax
shall be dealt with as follows :
(a) Apart from confiscation of the goods,
those who fail to pay any tax shall
be subject to a fine of not less than
five times and not more than ten times
the original rate.
(b) Those who fail to pay sufficient tax
shall be subject to a fine of not more
than five times the original rate.

Article 9:
These regulations will be effective from the
date on which permission is granted for their
promulgation. Amendment may be made to these
regulations if necessary.

在江苏-浙江-安徽税务局管辖区域内，
已缴纳税款的汽水不再另行征收。

第七条：
汽水运输和检查的程序另行
制定。

第八条：
未缴纳必要税款者按以下方式处理：
(a) 除没收货物外，未缴纳任何税款者
将被处以不低于原税率五倍且
不超过十倍的罚款。
(b) 未足额缴纳税款者将被处以
不超过原税率五倍的罚款。

第九条：
本条例自批准颁布之日起生效。
如有必要，可对本条例进行修订。

Subject. Illegal Functioning of Inspectors employed by the Consolidated Tax
Bureau of Kiangsu, Chekiang and Anhwei.
Made by D.S.I. Lee Yee Tong. Forwarded by **〔此处转录不清〕**

Sir,
At 7 p.m. May 6th 1940, C.D.C. 363 brought to
Yulin Road Station two male Chinese named (1) Shu Fong
(舒芳), 23, Ningpo, and (2) Fan Hsueh Wei (范学卫), 27,
Ningpo, who reside at Lane 208, House 170, Yang-
chow Road, on suspicion of having stolen a quantity of
cigarette paper.
Enquiries ascertained that at about 6.30 p.m. May
6th 1940, C.D.C. 363 was patrolling in the vicinity of
Lane 208, Yangchow Road, where a female named Zao Chien
Sz (赵钱氏), residing at 9, Ling Chin Lee (林金利),
Lingching Road, raised an alarm. The female informed
the detective that thieves residing in Lane 208, House
170, Yangchow Road, had stolen 30 catties of cigarette
paper. The detective then entered the house, detained
the two above mentioned persons, and recovered three
packets of cigarette paper.
The female also informed detectives that
she purchased the packages of cigarette paper for the
sum of $138.00, at a certain address in Rue Hue, F.C.
She intended to use the paper to roll cigarettes on a
hand machine, at her home. When she alighted from a
Japanese bus, at Yangtsepoo Road near Washing Road,
she was accosted by three male Chinese who seized the
package containing the cigarette paper, and forced her
to accompany them to the address at Yangchow Road. These
men told her that she would have to pay $60.00 tax on
the paper, and warned her not to inform the Police or
she would be sent to the Japanese Military Headquarters.

先生，
1940年5月6日晚上7点，华捕探员（C.D.C.）363号将两名中国男子带至榆林路分局，分别为 (1) 舒芳（Shu Fong），23岁，宁波人，和 (2) 范学卫（Fan Hsueh Wei），27岁，宁波人，两人居住在扬州路208弄170号，涉嫌盗窃大量卷烟纸。
经查询查明，1940年5月6日下午6点30分左右，华捕探员363号在扬州路208弄附近巡逻时，一名名为赵钱氏（Zao Chien Sz）的女子发出警报，她居住在临清路林金利9号。该女子告知探员，居住在扬州路208弄170号的小偷盗窃了30斤卷烟纸。探员随即进入屋内，拘留了上述两人，并查获三包卷烟纸。
该女子还告知探员，她在法租界霞飞路（Rue Hue）某地址以138.00美元的价格购买了这些卷烟纸。她打算在家中使用手摇机器用这些纸卷制香烟。当她在杨树浦路靠近 Washing Road（音译，可能指华盛路或类似地名）下车时，被三名中国男子拦住，他们抢走了装有卷烟纸的包裹，并强迫她随他们前往扬州路的地址。这些人告诉她，她必须为这些纸缴纳60.00美元的税款，并警告她不得报警，否则会将她送往日本军方司令部。

April 13, 40.

Kiangsu-Chekiang-Anhwei Revenue Bureau - collection of
tax on aerated waters

The Kiangsu-Chekiang-Anhwei Revenue Bureau,
230 Kiukiang Road, has been collecting a tax on
aerated waters since 1938, the collection period
being from April 1 to the end of August every year.
Each one-pound-bottle of mineral water transported
into or from the district over which the Shanghai
City Government has jurisdiction, is required to
have affixed to it, a tax stamp costing one cent,
and each 1½ lb. bottle, a tax stamp costing 1½ cents,
and so on, but waters produced and sold in the
Foreign Settlements do not require tax stamps.
The collection this year started on April 1 as usual.

In 1938 the tax was collected in the name
of the "Kiangsu Province Mineral Water Tax
Collecting Office" (4th floor of No.230 Kiukiang
Road). This office was abolished in 1939 when the
present collecting office (at the same address) -
the Shang-Pao (Shanghai and Paoshan) Collecting
Office of the Tobacco and Wine Tax Bureau - was
established in its stead.

The Inspection Office of the "Kiangsu
Province Mineral Water Tax Collecting Office" at
No.35-E Brenan Road, O.O.L., was abolished at the
same time. This place is now used as offices by
the "Western District Branch of the Joss Paper
Inspection Office" of the Kiangsu-Chekiang-Anhwei

江苏-浙江-安徽税务局 - 汽水税收征收

江苏-浙江-安徽税务局（九江路 230 号）自 1938 年起一直征收汽水税，征收期为每年 4 月 1 日至 8 月底。凡运入或运出上海市政府管辖区域的每瓶一磅装矿泉水，须张贴价值一分的印花税票，每瓶 1.5 磅装须张贴价值一分半的印花税票，依此类推；但在外国租界内生产并销售的汽水无需张贴印花税票。今年的征收工作如常于 4 月 1 日开始。

1938 年，税收是以“江苏省矿泉水征税处”（九江路 230 号 4 楼）的名义征收的。该处于 1939 年被撤销，取而代之的是在同一地址成立的现行征税机构——烟酒税务局沪宝（上海及宝山）征税处。

位于老闸捕房辖区勃伦南路 35-E 号的“江苏省矿泉水征税处”稽查所也同时被撤销。该地现由江苏-浙江-安徽税务局的“锡箔稽查所西区支所”及该局“第二区支稽查所”用作办公室，

Mr. Crokam of Caldbeck Macgregor, Foochow
Road was interviewed on the 12th April, 1940,
when he explained that the goods which had been
seized on April 10, 1940 by the Kiangsu-Chekiang-
Anhwei Revenue Bureau had been released through
efforts on the part of a Chinese member of the
firm whose name he did not wish to disclose and
further that he was unaware of how the release
had been affected. When the office of the bureau
was visited by the Chinese member of the firm at
No. 35D Brenan Road, and after the negotiations
had finished Mr. Crokam states that the bureau
people gave them to understand that in future
consignments being found on the extra-Settlement
roads on which no stamp tax had been paid would
lead to further inconveniencing of the firm's
transporting business.

In these circumstances taking into consideration
that the roads were municipal property and the firm
being a municipal ratepayer, Mr. Crokam asked what
protection could be afforded them in the carrying
out of their business in that area.

It will be seen from a report of July 25,
1938 (flagged) where the same firm had trouble with
the Kiangsu-Chekiang-Anhwei Revenue Bureau and in
which a foreign member of the firm of Caldbeck's
made the necessary adjustments with the Head Office

1940 年 4 月 12 日会见了福州路 Caldbeck Macgregor 公司的 Crokam 先生，他解释说，1940 年 4 月 10 日被江苏-浙江-安徽税务局扣押的货物，已通过该公司一位不愿透露姓名的华籍成员的努力得以释放，此外他并不知晓释放是如何达成的。当该公司的华籍成员前往勃伦南路 35D 号的税务局办事处进行谈判结束后，Crokam 先生称，税务局人员让他们明白，今后若在租界外道路上发现未缴纳印花税的货物，将会给该公司的运输业务带来进一步的不便。

鉴于道路属于工部局财产，且该公司为工部局纳税人，Crokam 先生询问在该区域开展业务时能获得何种保护。

Subject. Kiangsu-Chekiang-Anhwei Revenue Bureau - collection of
tax on aerated waters

Made by. C. D. I. Sih Tse-liang Forwarded by. D. I. Crawford

The Kiangsu-Chekiang-Anhwei Revenue Bureau,
230 Kiukiang Road, has been collecting a tax on
aerated waters since 1938, the collection period
being from April 1 to the end of August every year.
Each one-pound-bottle of mineral water transported
into or from the district over which the Shanghai
City Government has jurisdiction, is required to
have affixed to it, a tax stamp costing one cent,
and each 1½ lb. bottle, a tax stamp costing 1½ cents,
and so on, but waters produced and sold in the
Foreign Settlements do not require tax stamps.
The collection this year started on April 1 as usual.

In 1938 the tax was collected in the name
of the "Kiangsu Province Mineral Water Tax
Collecting Office" (4th floor of No.230 Kiukiang
Road). This office was abolished in 1939 when the
present collecting office (at the same address) -
the Shang-Pao (Shanghai and Paoshan) Collecting
Office of the Tobacco and Wine Tax Bureau - was
established in its stead.

The Inspection Office of the "Kiangsu
Province Mineral Water Tax Collecting Office" at
No.35-D Brenan Road, O.O.L., was abolished at the
same time. This place is now used as offices by
the "Western District Branch of the Joss Paper
Inspection Office" of the Kiangsu-Chekiang-Anhwei

日期：1940年4月15日。

事由：苏浙皖统税局——征收汽水税

呈报人：华探长施子良 (Sih Tse-liang) 转呈人：探长克劳福德 (Crawford)

苏浙皖统税局（九江路230号）自1938年起开始征收汽水税，征收期为每年4月1日至8月底。凡运入或运出上海市政府管辖区域的每瓶一磅装矿泉水，须贴面值一分的税票；每瓶一磅半装的，须贴面值一分半的税票，依此类推；但在外国租界内生产并销售的汽水无需贴税票。今年的征收工作如常于4月1日开始。

1938年，征税是以“江苏省矿泉水税征收处”（九江路230号4楼）的名义进行的。该处于1939年被撤销，取而代之的是现征收机构（同一地址）——烟酒税局沪宝（上海与宝山）征收处。

原位于北四川路35-D号的“江苏省矿泉水税征收处”稽查所也同时被撤销。该址现为苏浙皖统税局“纸箔稽查所西区支所”办公之用。

参见特务科
报告
- 1938年7月22日。

Mr. Crokam of Caldbeck Macgregor, Foochow Road was interviewed on the 12th April, 1940, when he explained that the goods which had been seized on April 10, 1940 by the Kiangsu-Chekiang-Anhwei Revenue Bureau had been released through efforts on the part of a Chinese member of the firm whose name he did not wish to disclose and further that he was unaware of how the release had been affected. When the office of the bureau was visited by the Chinese member of the firm at No. 35D Brenan Road, and after the negotiations had finished Mr. Crokam states that the bureau people gave them to understand that in future consignments being found on the extra-Settlement roads on which no stamp tax had been paid would lead to further inconveniencing of the firm's transporting business.

In those circumstances taking into consideration that the roads were municipal property and the firm being a municipal ratepayer, Mr. Crokam asked what protection could be afforded them in the carrying out of their business in that area.

It will be seen from a report of July 25, 1938 (flagged) where the same firm had trouble with the Kiangsu-Chekiang-Anhwei Revenue Bureau and in which a foreign member of the firm of Caldbeck's made the necessary adjustments with the Head Office

1940年4月12日约谈了福州路 Caldbeck Macgregor 公司的克罗卡姆 (Crokam) 先生，他解释说，1940年4月10日被苏浙皖统税局扣押的货物，是通过该公司一位不愿透露姓名的华籍职员努力后获释的，此外他不清楚释放的具体过程。当该公司的华籍职员前往北四川路35-D号的该局办公室时，谈判结束后，克罗卡姆先生称，该局人员向他们表示，今后若在租界外道路上发现未缴纳印花税的货物，将给该公司的运输业务带来进一步的不便。

"Kiangsu, Chekiang and Anhwei Consolidated Tax Bureau,
April 1st., 1940.

To the Manager of Messrs Liddell Brothers,
1140 Yangtsepoo Road.

Dear Sir,

Since January 1938, our bureau has been re-organised under the control of the Ministry of Finance and we have been collecting taxes on all kinds of Foreign and Chinese goods in the same way as before.

Yangtzepoo Station
REPORT
Date March 12, 1940.

Subject. Illegal functioning of Shanghai City Government Police Bureau.

Made by.... D.S. Barker-Smith ............Forwarded by. ........................................

Sir,

At 6.15 a.m. 12/3/40 six male Chinese namely, Zung Van Tsang ( 張萬昌 ), 43 May Road, Lau Dong Yue ( 劉東裕 ) 134 Thorburn Road, Liu Koo Shing ( 劉古成 ), O.O.L., Fan Meu Te ( 樊茂德 ), 54 Thorburn Road, Ts Yoong Chun ( 朱永春 ), 631 Ying Hsiang Kong, Ts Lee Lee ( 朱利利 ), 631 Ying Hsiang Kong, came to the station and the first four named reported that Shanghai City Government Police had illegally functioned in the Settlement.

All these men, who are acquaintances, are hawkers of wood and buy their stocks in Chapei and bring them into the Settlement to be sold.

On 10/3/40 at about 6 a.m. whilst the first four named men were transporting a load of wood on two hand-carts, three Shanghai City Government Police Bureau constables in uniform stopped them on Jinching Road bridge and demanded to see their pass permitting them to take wood from Chapei. As the men had no pass, the policemen ordered them to turn back and they were escorted to a Police Station in Chapei, detained for some hours and their wood was confiscated.

The four men, knowing that the last two named had a pass, suspected them of having given information to the City Government Police Bureau in order to spoil their business; this allegation is denied by the last two named, and, even if true, their action does not constitute an offence.

S. Smith
Sen. Det. 1/c.

D.D.O. "D"
Copy to P.C. Davis

R Barker Smith

1940年3月12日上午6时15分，六名中国男子，即：张万昌 (Zung Van Tsang)，梅园路43号；刘东裕 (Lau Dong Yue)，韬朋路134号；刘古成 (Liu Koo Shing)，越界筑路区；樊茂德 (Fan Meu Te)，韬朋路54号；朱永春 (Ts Yoong Chun)，引翔港631号；朱利利 (Ts Lee Lee)，引翔港631号，来到捕房，前四名男子报告称上海市政府警察在租界内非法行使职权。

这些人均相识，均为木柴小贩，他们在闸北进货，然后带入租界出售。

1940年3月10日上午6时许，当前述四名男子用两辆手推车运送一批木柴时，三名身穿制服的上海市政府警察局巡捕在金城路桥上拦住他们，要求查看允许他们从闸北运出木柴的通行证。由于这些人没有通行证，巡捕命令他们返回，并将他们押送至闸北的一个警察局，拘留数小时，没收了他们的木柴。

这四名男子知道最后两名男子持有通行证，怀疑他们向上海市政府警察局告密以破坏其生意；最后两名男子否认了这一指控，而且即使属实，他们的行为也不构成犯罪。

Sir,

During the afternoon of the 16-1-40, Mr. C. F. D. Lowe
of Messrs. Liddell Bros. & Co. Ltd., No. 4 Peking Road,
reported that the Kiangsu-Chekiang & Anhwei Line Tax
Bureau were endeavouring to collect taxes from his company.
Inquiries made by the undersigned ascertained the follow-
ing from Mr. Lowe :-

Sometime during April 1939, his company received a
letter through Melcher & Co. (agents) from the Tax
Bureau informing them that they would have to pay 59
cents per gallon of spirits distilled by the company at
their distillery at 1140 Yangtszepoo Road. The company
replied that as the spirit was a local product and was
for local consumption and not for export and further,
that as it was made within the International Settlement,
they therefore declined to pay the tax.

Nothing further was heard from the Bureau for several
months, when another letter was received written on the
same lines as the first but adding that unless the tax
was paid, action would be taken. This letter was ignored
by the company. Further letters were then received to
which the company replied in the same terms and adding
that communications should be sent to the Head Office,
No. 4 Peking Road.

On the 5-1-40, another letter was received through
Thompson & Co. (successors to Melcher & Co.) stating that
the tax must be paid, otherwise steps would be taken, the
company however still declined to recognise the Bureau.

1940年1月16日下午，北京路4号利德尔兄弟有限公司（Messrs. Liddell Bros. & Co. Ltd.）的 C. F. D. Lowe 先生报告称，江苏浙江安徽线税务局正试图向其公司征税。经署名者询问，从 Lowe 先生处获悉以下情况：

1939年4月间的某个时候，他的公司通过美最时洋行（Melcher & Co.，代理商）收到税务局的一封信，通知他们必须为公司位于杨树浦路1140号的蒸馏厂所蒸馏的每一加仑烈酒支付59美分。公司回复称，由于该烈酒是本地产品，供本地消费而非出口，且是在公共租界内生产的，因此拒绝缴纳税款。

此后数月未收到税务局的进一步消息，随后又收到一封信，内容与第一封相同，但补充说除非缴纳税款，否则将采取行动。公司忽略了这封信。随后又收到更多信件，公司以同样的措辞回复，并补充说通信应发送至北京路4号总公司。

1940年1月5日，通过汤普森洋行（Thompson & Co.，美最时洋行的继任者）收到另一封信，称必须缴纳税款，否则将采取措施，但公司仍拒绝承认该税务局。

During the conversation at H.B.M. Consulate, Mr. Lowe

Mr. Lowe informed the undersigned that his company did not
wish to make a complaint at the Japanese Consulate, because
the Japanese director of the Mei Lee Chemical Factory, 802

owing to the Bureau continually endeavouring to collect
taxes from them on the spirits made at the factory. There-
fore, Mr. Lowe and his company are hoping that this Japanese
director will succeed in bringing pressure to bear on the

Mr. Lowe requested that police be in the vicinity of
the factory at 1140 Yangtsepoo Road at 9.30 a.m. when

attempt is made to stop the truck. Mr. Lowe also requested
that the police take no action whatsoever no matter what

载着每日运往上海的烈酒离开杨树浦路1140号的蒸馏厂，车上有一名懂日语的英籍员工。当卡车行驶在杨树浦路上时，该局的四名中国男性成员试图拦截卡车，其明显目的是扣押烈酒。由于此前已指示该外籍员工除非被迫否则不要为任何人停车，他指示司机继续驾驶，司机照办，烈酒遂被顺利运至苏州河以南。

Lowe 先生得知上述情况后，立即前往英国驻华领事馆，并向总领事通报。

在英国领事馆的谈话中，有人建议 Lowe 先生向日本领事馆投诉。Lowe 先生告知署名者，他的公司不愿向日本领事馆投诉，因为卫斯理路808号（Wayside Road，译注：原文为802，通常指美利化学工厂地址，此处依原文译）美利化学工厂（Mei Lee Chemical Factory，一家由日本人担任董事的中国企业）的日本董事正因该局不断试图对其工厂生产的烈酒征税而打算去日本领事馆办理同一事项。因此，Lowe 先生及其公司希望这位日本董事能在不牵涉利德尔公司的情况下，成功对该局施加压力。

Lowe 先生请求警方在上午9时30分其卡车离开前往上海时，在杨树浦路1140号工厂附近驻守，以便在再次试图拦截卡车时作为见证人。Lowe 先生还请求警方无论发生什么情况都不要采取任何行动，因为他的公司不希望事态扩大。鉴于这一请求，将部署两名侦探在附近，指令是做记录但不采取行动。

December 15, 1939.

Dear Mr. Fan,

（批：Copy of original in Chinese.）

Your letter noted. Regarding your request
to investigate the arrest and detention of one Chu Yeu Sze
at the Yangtsepoo Sub-Station and to stop such cases
of arrest, I have made enquiries by telephone from the
Chapei and Civic Centre police stations, which are in the
vicinity of the incident, but they replied that there
was no such arrest made. As your report did not give
the exact address of the sub-station, it was difficult
to make investigations. Will you please let me know
the exact location of the Yangtsepoo sub-station (the
name of street and number of house) so that further
enquiries may be made. There is no sub-station at
Yangtsepoo and it may be some other organ which was
involved in this case. Please inform your Commissioner
that I myself do not agree with arrests within your
jurisdiction without first informing you and that I have
repeatedly instructed my subordinates to stop such arrests.

(Sd) Loo Ying.

D.C. Crime
Information

（印：DEPUTY COMMISSIONER CRIME BRANCH）

at 7.30 a.m. on the 13/12/39, by the C.C.P.Bureau.

from him.

It was seen that the left hand of Ts Yue Ss
was swollen, and he stated that it was caused by having
been struck with a wooden bar whilst in the custody
of the C.C.P.Bureau.

He did not wish to attend hospital, and further
stated that he considered the incident closed, as he
wished to keep it as quiet as possible, so that it
would not interfere with his business.

strongly denied.

A record of the quarrel with Loh Foh Sung ( 陸福生 )
who he refers to in his statement, was made at the
Kashing Road Station at 2.50 p.m. on the 27/11/39.

1939年12月13日上午8时45分，朱张氏（Ts Tsang Sz）向本分局报案称，其丈夫朱友士（Ts Yue Ss）已于1939年12月13日上午7时30分由中央捕房局释放。

经查，朱友士左手肿胀，他声称这是在中央捕房局羁押期间被木棍击打所致。

他不希望前往医院就诊，并进一步表示他认为此事已了结，因为他希望尽可能保持低调，以免干扰其生意。

看来有人向中央捕房局举报他盗窃铁器，但他对此坚决否认。

他在供词中提到的与陆福生（Loh Foh Sung）的争吵记录，已于1939年11月27日下午2时50分在嘉善路分局备案。该争吵已和平解决。

The following is the statement of Tsu Yue Sz

My name is Tsu Yue Sz, age 34, native of Ningpo, Married
residing Lane 93/76, Urga Road.

I am the proprietor of the Tsu Ching Kyi Machinery Shop,
I and my family reside in the shop premises. The above shop
was established on the 1/4/37, and the work of the shop was
suspended at the commencement of the Sino-Japanese Conflict.
We manufactured machines for the Central Company, 8, Kiangwan
Road, owned by a Japanese named Mizutani.

At the commencement of the hostilities I and my family
evacuated my shop and removed to Toong Kah Doo, Pootung. On
May 1938 I and my family removed back to the above shop (Lane
93/76, Urga Road) to resume my business. The business of my
shop was conducted between the Central Company and several
Japanese owned concerns, and we mainly made iron materials
for building.

Since the re-opening of my shop my business was carried
on satisfactorily.

At 2.15 p.m. on the 27/11/39 I had a quarrel with one
one named Loh Foh Sung, residing No.64, of the above alleyway.
This case was reported to Kashing Road Police Station and owing
to trivial nature both parties were released after having been
cautioned.

At 8.45 p.m. on the 8/12/39 my apprentice named Ying
Ts Faung was working in the alleyway, when Loh Foh Sung's
son, named Loh Zien Kung (his occupation is believed to be
an interpreter employed by a Japanese concern) passed the
locality and complained to the apprentice for causing abstruc-

本人姓名朱友士，年龄34岁，宁波籍，已婚，居住于乌拉尔路（Urga Road）93弄76号。

本人是朱庆记机器厂店主，本人及家属居住在店铺内。上述店铺成立于1937年4月1日，中日冲突爆发时店铺停工。我们曾为江湾路8号由日本人水谷（Mizutani）所有的中央公司制造机器。

战事爆发初期，本人及家属撤离店铺，迁至浦东唐家渡（Toong Kah Doo）。1938年5月，本人及家属搬回上述店铺（乌拉尔路93弄76号）恢复营业。本店业务主要在中央公司与几家日商企业之间开展，主要制造建筑用铁料。

自店铺重新开业以来，生意经营顺利。

1939年11月27日下午2时15分，本人与居住在同弄堂64号的陆福生发生争吵。此案已报至嘉善路警察分局，因性质轻微，双方在接受警告后均被释放。

1939年12月8日晚上8时45分，本人的学徒应茨芳（Ying Ts Faung，音译）正在弄堂内工作，此时陆福生之子陆建公（Loh Zien Kung，音译，据信其职业为受雇于日商企业的翻译）经过此地，并向学徒抱怨其造成弄堂阻

At 7.10.p.m. on the 12.12.39, one named Ts Tsang Sz (许张氏) aged 30 years, native of Ningpo, residing 93/76 urga Road, telephoned the Kashing Road Station to the effect that two men, one armed had entered their house, and had taken away her husband named Ls Yue Sz (李月士) aged 34 years.

Enquiries by C.D.C 151, D.S 746 Saito and the undersigned ascertained that at the above time and date one Male Japanese armed with a pistol and a male Chinese, both in civilian dress entered the said premises and took away Ls Yue Sz, prior to which they tied his arms with string. Further enquiries ascertained that a member of the C.C.P. Bureau with his Chinese assistant of the Yangtszepoo sub-station arrested Ls Yue Sz, and took him to the said sub-station.

From the wife of Ts Yue Sz it is learned that her husband for three years prior to the Sino-Japanese Hostilities and for the past eighteen months worked for Japanese concerns in making iron frames for the construction of buildings.

D.S. Saito learned from Mr. G Mizutani of No. 8 Klangwan Road who Ls Yue Sz has recently worked for

（印：DEPUTY COMMISSIONER 13 DEC. 1939 CRIME BRANCH）

一名中国男子在乌拉尔路（urga Road）93弄76号被杨树浦路分巡捕房的中央捕房局（C.C.P.Bureau）人员逮捕。

1939年12月12日晚上7时10分，许张氏（Ts Tsang Sz，原文如此，前文作朱张氏），30岁，宁波籍，居住于乌拉尔路93弄76号，致电嘉善路分局，称两名男子（其中一人持有武器）进入其住所，并带走了其丈夫李月士（Ls Yue Sz，原文如此，前文作朱友士），34岁。

经刑事侦探警员151号、警佐746号斋藤（Saito）及具名者查询，查明在上述时间和日期，一名持手枪的日本男子和一名中国男子，均身着便服，进入上述处所，并在之前用绳子捆绑了李月士的双臂，将其带走。进一步查询查明，中央捕房局的一名成员及其杨树浦分巡捕房的中国助手逮捕了李月士，并将其带至该分巡捕房。

从朱友士的妻子处获悉，其丈夫在中日敌对行动前的三年以及过去十八个月中，一直为日商企业工作，制造建筑用铁框架。

警佐斋藤从江湾路8号的水谷（G Mizutani）先生处了解到李月士最近为其工作

（印章：刑事科副督察长 1939年12月13日）

At 8.10 a.m. on the 13/12/39, Ts Tseng Sz
(朱蔭氏), reported at this station that her
husband Ts Yue Ss (朱友士), had been released
at 7.00 p.m. on the 13/12/39, by the C.C.P.Bureau.

Subsequently the attached statement was taken
from him.

It was seen that the left hand of Ts Yue Ss
was swollen, and he stated that it was caused by having
been struck with a wooden bar whilst in the custody
of the C.C.P.Bureau.

He did not wish to attend hospital, and further
stated that he considered the incident closed, as he
wished to keep it as quiet as possible, so that it
would not interfere with his business.

It would appear that information had been given
to the C.C.P.Bureau, that he had stolen iron, which he
strongly denied.

Mr. Robertson,
D.C.(Special Branch)

A record of the quarrel with Loh Foh Sung (陸福生)
who he refers to in his statement, was made at the
Kashing Road Station at 2.50 p.m. on the 27/11/39.
The quarrel was amicably settled.

D.D.C."C" Division.

1939年12月13日上午8时10分，朱蔭氏（Ts Tseng Sz）向本分局报案称，其丈夫朱友士（Ts Yue Ss）已于1939年12月13日晚上7时由中央捕房局释放。

经查，朱友士左手肿胀，他声称这是在中央捕房局羁押期间被木棍击打所致。

The following is the statement of Tsu Yue Ss ............................................................

My name is Tsu Yue Ss, age 34, native of Ningpo, Married
residing Lane 93/76, Urge Road.
I am the proprietor of the Tsu Ching Kyi Machinery Shop,
I and my family reside in the shop premises. The above shop
was established on the 1/4/37, and the work of the shop was
suspended at the commencement of the Sino-Japanese Conflict.
We manufactured machines for the Central Company, 8, Kiangwan
Road, owned by a Japanese named Mizutari.
At the commencement of the hostilities I and my family
evacuated my shop and removed to Toong Kah Doo, Pootung. On
May 1938 I and my family removed back to the above shop, (Lane
93/76, Urge Road) to resume my business. The business of my
shop was conducted between the Central Company and several
Japanese owned concerns, and we mainly made iron materials
for building.
Since the re-opening of my shop my business was carried
on satisfactorily.
At 2.15 p.m. on the 27/11/39 I had a quarrel with one
one named Loh Foh Sung, residing No.64, of the above alleyway.
This case was reported to Kashing Road Police Station and owing
to trivial nature both parties were released after having been
cautioned.
At 8.45 p.m. on the 8/12/39 my apprentice named Ying
Ts Faung was working in the alleyway, when Loh Foh Sung's
son, named Loh Zien Kung (his occupation is believed to be
an interpreter employed by a Japanese concern) passed the
locality and complained to the apprentice for causing abstruc-

本人名朱悦生，34岁，宁波籍，已婚，
住乌尔嘎路（Urge Road，即今乌鲁木齐北路一带，音译）93弄76号。
本人系朱庆记机器厂店主，
本人与家属均居住在店址内。上述店铺
成立于1937年4月1日，在中日冲突爆发之初，
店铺停工。
我们曾为江湾路8号中央公司制造机器，该公司
由一名名为水谷（Mizutari，音译）的日本人所有。
战事爆发之初，本人与家属撤离店铺，迁往浦东唐家渡（Toong Kah Doo，音译）。
1938年5月，本人与家属搬回上述店铺（乌尔嘎路93弄76号）恢复营业。本人店铺的业务
主要在中央公司与几家日商之间开展，主要制造建筑用铁料。
自重新开业以来，生意经营顺利。
1939年11月27日下午2时15分，本人与一名
名为罗福松（Loh Foh Sung，音译）的人发生争吵，此人住在上述弄堂64号。
此案已报至嘉善路捕房，因性质轻微，双方
在接受警告后均被释放。
1939年12月8日晚上8时45分，本人的学徒
应子芳（Ying Ts Faung，音译）正在弄堂里工作，此时罗福松之子
罗天公（Loh Zien Kung，音译，据信其职业为受雇于日商的翻译）经过该地，
并指责学徒造成弄堂阻

tion in the alleyway. Being dissatisfied with the apprentice's

that some day there may something happen.

At about 7 p.m. on the 14/12/39 two civilians (one
Japanese armed with pistol and one Chinese) entered my shop
and proceeded upstairs, where one of them asked who was Tsu
Yue S, whereupon I answered. They then bound me with a
piece of string and hired a public ricksha and took me away.
I was taken to the Japanese Consular Police Station on
Magnolia Road. On arrival there the Chinese male, who
participated in effecting my arrest, questioned me regarding
theft of iron, whereupon I replied that I had no knowledge
of same. At that moment he struck my hand with a wooden
bar (This was the cause of my injuries inflicted on my hand)
I then told the Japanese in black uniform that all the iron
used in my factory was purchased, and that separate invoices
for each transaction was kept on file in the shop, the Japanese
then told me to telephone to the shop requesting same to be
sent to the above station. This was complied with, and after
the Japanese had perused all the invoices he told me to
telephone to my family and say that I would be released
on the following morning. The Japanese then told me to
retire in the next room, which was guarded by two persons.
I saw the accountant of the Central Company speak to the
Japanese, when he was informed that after enquiries had been
concluded, I would be released on the following morning.
At 7.30 p.m. on the 15/12/39 a Japanese wearing uniform

并走上楼，其中一人问谁是朱悦生（Tsu Yue S），
本人随即应答。随后他们用一根绳子将本人捆绑，
雇了一辆公共人力车将本人带走。
本人被带至木兰路（Magnolia Road，即今多伦路）日本领事警察署。
到达那里后，参与实施逮捕的那名中国男子
就盗窃铁料一事审问本人，本人回答说对此
一无所知。当时他用一根木棍击打我的手
（这就是我手部受伤的原因）。
随后我告诉那名穿黑色制服的日本人，工厂使用的
所有铁料均为购买所得，且每笔交易的单独发票
均存档于店内，该日本人随即让我打电话给店里，
要求将发票送至上述警署。此事照办，在日本人
查阅了所有发票后，他让我给家人打电话，说
我将于次日早晨获释。随后日本人让我
进入隔壁房间休息，该房间由两人看守。
我看见中央公司的会计与那名日本人交谈，
得知调查结束后，我将于次日早晨获释。

instructed the tea-boy to hire a ricksha for me, and the Japanese
riding a bicycle, accompanied me to my home.

On arrival at my shop the Japanese looked at my account
books and later the Japanese told me to communicate with the
accountant of the Central Company, requesting him to come to
my shop. On the arrival of the accountant, the Japanese then
wrote something on a piece of paper, which was copied and chopp-
ed by the accountant, and then handed over to the Japanese,
who put same in his pocket. He then told me to carry on
business as usual, and nothing would happen.

After this incident occurred, I thought that I had no
trouble with anybody other than my neighbour, Loh Poh Sung
and his son Loh Tien Kung, therefore they might be the person
responsible for my arrest.

At 10 a.m. on the 4/4/39 I was called to the Kashing
Road Police Station, where I related what had happened.

The above is my true statement.

Signed and chopped by Tsu Yue Sz

吩咐茶役为我雇一辆人力车，该日本人
骑着自行车，陪同我回家。

到达我的店铺后，日本人查看了我的账簿，
随后日本人让我联系中央公司的会计，请他

______W......Station,
REPORT
Date December 1, 1939.
Subject Further report on attempt to force a licence on a shop keeper in
Hongkew District by servants and slaves of the International Settlement Government.
Made by ______ and Forwarded by J. F. Wels. Insp. 'C'elfer,

Sir,

No. 857, Feiron Road is a small City Government co-operative called it when sample's place of business on the morning of December 1st, 1939.

From a personal survey by the undersigned it was learned that No. 857, Feiron Road is actually situated on the South side of Jukong Road (O.O.L.) and is about sixty yards east of Feiron Road. There are four shops east of it bearing the S.M.C. numbers 859, 861, 863 and 865. The other shop which is beyond them are about one yard south of their location and are in Chinese territory. The boundary stone of the International Settlement is inside No. 865, about six inches from the frontage, and is encased in a wooden box.

On the above information being ascertained and also after a personal supervision by the I.O. "C", he gave instructions that the P.K.D. be visited to ascertain the actual location of the shop at No. 857.

Mr. Lewis, Land Surveyor for the S.M.C. and Mr. C.H. Duff, assistant engineer, were interviewed and they stated that the shop No. 857, Feiron Road is situated in Cadastral Lot No. 1173, registered under U.S. Consular Lot No. 2733 and its frontage would be about 2½ feet out from the boundary. Actually to take any action at this particular section it is necessary to proceed to it on Jukong Road O.O.L., therefore it would be essential to obtain assistance from the O.O.L. Authorities as there is no back entrance to the shop situated at No. 857.

（左侧手写批注：）
Copy for Mr. J. Robertson.
S.C. (Special Branch)

日期 1939年12月1日。
主题 关于国际租界政府仆役和奴才试图强迫虹口区一店主领取执照的进一步报告。
由 ______ 制作，由 J. F. Wels. 督察 'C'elfer（原文不清，可能为Polfer或类似拼写）转发，

先生，

斐伦路（Feiron Road，即今海伦路）857号是一家小型市政府合作社，1939年12月1日上午，当样本（sample's，原文如此，可能指某人或某物）在其经营场所时……

经具名者亲自勘察，获悉斐伦路857号实际上位于久耕路（Jukong Road，即今九龙路）南侧（O.O.L.，越界筑路区），且在斐伦路以东约六十码处。其东侧有四家店铺，持有工部局编号859、861、863和865。位于这些店铺之外的另一家店铺，位置在其以南约一码处，属于中国领土。国际租界的界石位于865号内部，距临街面约六英寸，并封装在一个木箱内。

在查明上述信息并经“C”分区情报官（I.O. "C"）亲自监督后，他指示警务科（P.K.D.）前往探访，以确定857号店铺的实际位置。

会见了工部局土地测量师刘易斯先生（Mr. Lewis）和助理工程师达夫先生（Mr. C.H. Duff），他们表示，斐伦路857号店铺位于地籍地块第1173号，注册在美国领事馆地块第2733号名下，其临街面超出边界约2½英尺。实际上，要对该特定区域采取任何行动，必须通过久耕路越界筑路区（O.O.L.）进入，因此必须获得越界筑路区当局的协助，因为位于857号的店铺没有后门入口。

（左侧手写批注：）
抄送 J. Robertson 先生。
S.C. (特别课)

（左侧签名及潦草字迹：）
JR
C.S.
C.F.

（批：Copy for M. Mitchell.）

Sir,

About 11 a.m. on November 30th, 1939 a male
Chinese named Yu Wen Tsong (郁文忠) came to Hongkew
Police Station with a Shanghai Municipal Council "General
Municipal Rate (Chinese)" receipt (No.153) for quarter
ending December 31st, 1939, issued on October 31st, 1939,
for his place of business, a wine and grocery shop,
situated at No. 857 Herron Road, and reported that two
representatives of the Shanghai Special City Government
had come to the aforementioned address and attempted to
force a licence on him issued by their control.

He gave a voluntary statement, appended, with
reference to the incident and a summary of which is as
follows:-

About 8 a.m. on November 29th, 1939 two male
Chinese representing themselves to be members
of the Eastern Branch of the Shanghai Special
City Government, both wearing enamel badges
denoting same, came to my shop and asked me
to make application for a "Business Licence"
from them. They gave their office address as
Chih Ai Lee (枝善里) Jukong Road, Chapel.
I refused on the grounds that my place of
business was situated in the International
Settlement. However, they insisted I apply
for this licence otherwise my shop would be
closed immediately. Over and above they
stated all shops inside the barbed wire area
came under the control of their government,

The following is the statement of  Zau Wen Tsong ( 趙文忠 ), age 34, M/wine and

at Hongkew Stn. on the 30/11/39. and interpreted by ____________________

I was the shop keeper of the Sai Foong ( 瑞丰 ) Wine and
Grocery shop, at 867 Fenron Road but I evacuated from the shop
immediately after the outbreak of the Sino-Japanese hostilities
in 1937. On 27/7/39 I returned to the shop after having obtain-
ed a Japanese pass. Towards the end of August 1939 after
having had all necessary fittings made for the premises I
started to do business. I intended to apply for a licence
from the Shanghai Municipal Council but so far I have not
made the written application for same.

At 8 a.m. on 29/11/39, two men, representing them-
selves as members of the Eastern Branch of the Shanghai City
Government, both wearing enamel badges denoting same, came to
my shop and asked me to make application for a "Business
Licence" from the said Government, giving their office address
as Chih Lai Lee ( 積善里 ) Jukong Road, Chapei. I refused on
the grounds that my shop is situated inside the International
Settlement, However, they insisted I apply for a licence
from them otherwise my shop would be closed immediately. They
added that all shops inside the barbed wire barriers came
under the control of the said Government and that they would
give me sometime to make enquiries among other shops. They,
then, leaving a blank form for me to apply for a licence, left
my shop.

At 8 a.m. 30/11/39 one of the two men, who came to my
shop yesterday, whose description is as follows:- height
about 5'7", age about 40, stout build, square face, pale
complexion, wearing dark coloured long gown, fur hat, speaking

以下为赵文忠（Zau Wen Tsong），34岁，籍贯福建（Foo tung，音译），汾伦路867号酒杂货店店主，于1939年11月30日在虹口警署由高级侦缉督察钟元清（Chung Yuan Ching，音译）先生录取，并由___翻译的供词。

我是位于汾伦路867号的瑞丰（Sai Foong）酒杂货店的店主，但在1937年中日敌对行动爆发后，我立即撤离了该店。1939年7月27日，我在获得日本通行证后返回店内。1939年8月底，在完成场所的所有必要装修后，我开始营业。我打算向上海公共租界工部局申请执照，但至今尚未提交书面申请。

1939年11月29日上午8点，两名自称是上海市政府东部分局成员的男子来到我的店里，两人都佩戴着表明身份的珐琅徽章，要求我向上述政府申请“营业执照”，并称其办公地址为闸北朱恭路积善里（Chih Lai Lee）。我以我的店铺位于国际租界内为由予以拒绝。然而，他们坚持要我向他们申请执照，否则我的店铺将立即被关闭。他们补充说，铁丝网屏障内的所有店铺均受该政府管辖，并表示会给我一些时间向其他店铺查询。随后，他们留下一份空白申请表让我申请执照，便离开了我的店铺。

The illegal functioning in the Settlement and unlawful detention of two Chinese employees of the Sai Tai Tobacco Leaf Hong (三泰菸葉行), 11, Yeong An Faung (永安坊), Rue Laguerre (永安街), French Concession, by representatives of the Consolidated Tax Bureau of Kiangsu, Chekiang and Anhwei Provinces (蘇浙皖統稅局), 230 Kinkiang Road, was reported at Central Police Station at 8.30p.m. November 17, 1939 by Mr. Wong Yoong Liang (王泳梁), proprietor of the Sai Tai Tobacco Leaf Hong.

Mr. Wong Yoong Liang stated that he had been informed of the men's arrest by the Tax Bureau officials by other employees who had witnessed the incident, and that one of the victims had since telephoned him from the Tax Bureau stating that officials of that Bureau had arranged that they be released on payment of $5,000 Hall.

The incident occurred at about 4p.m. November 17, and the two men were taken away by the Tax Bureau people and detained in an apartment named Wing To Fong

江苏、浙江、安徽三省统税局（蘇浙皖統稅局，办公地址：九江路230号）代表在法租界永安街（Rue Laguerre）永安坊11号的三泰菸葉行（Sai Tai Tobacco Leaf Hong）非法在租界内活动并非法拘留该行两名中国员工一事，由三泰菸葉行店主王泳梁（Wong Yoong Liang）先生于1939年11月17日晚8点30分向中央警署报案。

王泳梁先生称，他是从目睹此事的其他员工处得知员工被税务局官员逮捕的消息，其中一名受害者随后从税务局打电话给他，称该局官员已安排他们在支付5,000海拉尔元（Hall dollars）后获释。

此事发生于11月17日下午4点左右，两名男子被税务局人员带走，并拘禁在一处名为永桃坊（Wing To Fong）的公寓内

(王兰芳) and a coolie named Ta Mo Sung (〔此处转录不清〕).
The arrest of these men was certainly carried
out in an illegal and high-handed manner and in
consequence of this D.S.I. Moir and C.D.S. 114
proceeded to the offices of the Consolidated Tax
Bureau at 8.45p.m. November 17 to negotiate for the
release of the victims.
No one in authority was found to be present in
the office and the two victims were located in a
room on the top floor of the building. The door of
this room was found to be locked on the inside and
the two victims were evidently being watched by
three male Chinese who claimed to be teaboys and
coolies employed by the Tax Bureau. It appeared
quite obvious that these men had been left behind
to guard and prevent the victims from leaving the
building should they have attempted.
The two detained men were immediately removed
from the premises by detectives and escorted to
Central Station where they were questioned and
statements taken.
Enquiries revealed that at 12.30p.m. November 17,
1939, Mr. Wong Yeong Liang instructed Wong Ts Fong
to remove 30 bales of tobacco leaf weighing approxim
pages.zh:
1/第2页。

（王兰芳）以及一名名为达莫松（Ta Mo Sung，〔此处转录不清〕）的苦力。
对这些人的逮捕显然是以非法且专横的方式进行的，因此，莫伊尔（Moir）高级侦缉督察和第114号刑事侦缉警长于11月17日晚8点45分前往统税局办公室，协商释放受害者。
办公室内未发现任何负责人在场，两名受害者被发现在大楼顶层的一个房间内。该房间的门发现是从内部锁上的，两名受害者显然正受到三名自称是税务局雇用的茶房和苦力的华籍男子的监视。很明显，这些人是被留下来看守的，以防受害者试图离开大楼。
两名被拘留男子随即被侦探带离该处，并护送至中央警署，在那里接受了讯问并录取了供词。
经查询，1939年11月17日中午12点30分，王泳良（Wong Yeong Liang）先生指示王茨丰（Wong Ts Fong，音译）移除大约

ly 3,900 catties from the Tai Chong Godown (泰昌),
Avenue Edward VII, French Concession to the Dah An
Godown (大安棧) situated at the corner of Canton
and Kiangse Roads.

At about 6p.m. five or six males claiming to
be Inspectors in the employ of the Consolidated Tax
Bureau appeared in the vicinity of the Dah An
Godown and demanded that Weng Ts Fong produce the
tax certificate for examination.

A certificate issued by the Ningpo Authorities
showing that tax had been paid on the tobacco leaf
was then produced by Weng Ts Fong for examination.

Weng was informed that such a certificate was
only valid in the interior and that tax would have
to be paid to the Shanghai Authorities.

The Inspectors to enforce payment of the tax
compelled Weng Ts Fong and Ts Ho Sung to accompany
them to the Tax Bureau 280 Kinkiang Road.

On arrival at 280 Kinkiang Road Weng was
informed by two officials, namely, Tsang (張) and
Yen (嚴) that he and the coolie would be released
on payment of $8,000 as all the tobacco leaf had
been deposited inside the godown.

He was also informed that if the money was not

3,900斤重、共30包的烟草叶，从法租界爱德华七世大道的泰昌栈（Tai Chong Godown）运至位于广东路与江西路拐角处的大安栈（Dah An Godown）。

下午6点左右，五六名自称是统税局雇员的稽查员出现在大安栈附近，并要求翁茨丰（Weng Ts Fong，音译）出示完税证以供检查。

翁茨丰随即出示了一份由宁波当局签发的证明，显示该批烟草叶已缴纳税款。

翁被告知，此类证书仅在内陆有效，必须向上海当局缴纳税款。

为了强制征税，稽查员强迫翁茨丰和曹和松（Ts Ho Sung，音译）陪同他们前往九江路280号的税务局。

到达九江路280号后，翁被告知，由于所有烟草叶已存入栈房，他和那名苦力需支付8,000元方可获释，负责此事的两名官员分别是张（Tsang）和严（Yen）。

他还被告知，如果钱款不

pages.en:
1/sheet 4.

paid they would be detained over-night and taken to
Hongkew the following morning.
They were advised to telephone their master
requesting an immediate settlement in order to
regain their freedom.
The Inspectors involved in the illegal act
and officials present in the room then departed
leaving both men in the care of the guards who were
found watching them when detectives arrived.
The arrest and detention of these men was
probably an attempt by minor officials of the Tax
Bureau to extort money from Mr. Wong Yeong Liang.
The very fact that they did not request Police
assistance is very suspicious and does definitely
show that those concerned were up to some unscrupulous
business.
There is also a possibility that high officials
of the Tax Bureau are not aware of the activities
of these people.
Such activities in the Settlement are certainly
most alarming and should be checked immediately
before these people get out of hand.

（批：Whincan
Sen.Det.1/c.
18/11
D. D. O. "A".）

支付，他们将被拘留过夜，并于次日早晨被带往虹口。
他们被建议打电话给他们的老板，请求立即解决此事以重获自由。
涉及非法行为的稽查员和当时在场的官员随后离开，将两人留给看守照看，侦探到达时发现这些看守正在监视他们。
对这些人的逮捕和拘留可能是税务局低级官员企图向王泳良先生勒索钱财的行为。
他们未请求警方协助这一事实非常可疑，确实表明相关人员从事某种不法勾当。
也有可能税务局的高级官员并不知晓这些人的活动。
此类在租界内的活动确实令人极为担忧，应在这些人失控之前立即予以制止。

Ts Mo Sang, age 41, Pootung.

Central Stn.           17-11-39.

    At 12.30p.m. 17/11/39 I was instructed by the proprietor
of the Sai Tai Tobacco Leaf Hong to accompany an employee
wong Ts Fong and another coolie Kong Ts Sui to deliver goods
from the Tai Chong Godown and transfer same to the Dah An
Godown situated on Canton Road.
    At about 6p.m. whilst we were storing the goods at
the Dah An Godown 5 or 6 Inspectors of the Consolidated Tax
Bureau of Kiangsu, Chekiang and Anhwei Provinces approached
us and brought me to the 4th floor of the Tax Bureau office
at No.230 Kiukiang Road where I was detained. wong Ts Fong
endeavoured to settle the matter with them, but we were
informed that unless a cash security of $3,000 was paid,
we would be taken to Hongkew. Guards have been placed over
us and they returned to their respective homes. At about
8.30p.m. police officers came and took us to the Police
Station.

                                sgd.

曹莫桑（Ts Mo Sang，音译），41岁，浦东人。

中央警署           1939年11月17日。

    1939年11月17日中午12点30分，我受三泰菸葉行店主指示，陪同员工王茨丰（wong Ts Fong，音译）和另一名苦力孔茨水（Kong Ts Sui，音译）从泰昌栈运送货物，并将其转移至位于广东路的大安栈。
    下午6点左右，当我们在大安栈存储货物时，江苏、浙江、安徽三省统税局的5或6名稽查员走近我们，并将我带至九江路230号税务局办公室的4楼，我在那里被拘留。王茨丰试图与他们解决此事，但我们被告知，除非支付3,000元现金作为担保，否则我们将被带往虹口。有人看守着我们，随后他们各自回家。晚上8点30分左右，警务人员到来，将我们带往警署。

                                签名

Wong Yoong Liang, age 37, Ningpo, proprietor
of the Sai Tai Tobacco Leaf Hong.

Central stn.          17-11-39.

    This afternoon I despatched an employee named Wong Ts
Fong and two coolies named Ts Mo Sung and Kong Ts Sui
to the Tai Chong Godown to deliver 38 bales of tobacco leaf
and store same in the Dah An Godown. Some time after
6p.m. the coolie Kong Ts Sui returned and reported that
Wong Ts Fong and coolie Ts Mo Sung had been detained by
Tax Inspectors on the 4th floor of the offices of the
Consolidated Tax Bureau of Kiangsu, Chekiang and Anhwei
Provinces, No.230 Kiukiang Road. Later, a telephone
message was received from Wong Ts Fong stating that
unless a cash security of $3,000 was paid they would not
be released. Therefore I reported the matter to the
station at 8.30p.m.

                                sgd.

黄永良（Wong Yoong Liang），37岁，宁波人，赛泰烟叶行（Sai Tai Tobacco Leaf Hong）店主。

中央巡捕房 1939年11月17日。

    今天下午，我派遣一名名叫黄子芳（Wong Ts Fong）的雇员和两名名叫朱茂松（Ts Mo Sung）及江子水（Kong Ts Sui）的苦力前往泰昌仓库（Tai Chong Godown），运送38包烟叶并存入大安仓库（Dah An Godown）。下午6点后不久，苦力江子水返回并报告称，黄子芳和苦力朱茂松在九江路230号苏浙皖统税局办公室四楼被税务稽查员扣留。随后，收到黄子芳打来的电话，称除非支付3,000美元现金保释金，否则他们不会被释放。因此，我在晚上8点30分向巡捕房报告了此事。

                                签名

pages.en:
Wong Ts Fong, age 27, Ningpo.

Central Stn. 17-11-39.

I am employed as an accountant at the Sai Tai Tobacco
Leaf Hong at No.11 Yoong An Faung, Rue Laguerre F.C.
At 12.30p.m. 17/11/39 I was instructed by the proprietor
to deliver 39 bales of tobacco leaf weighing approx. 3,900
catties from the Tai Chong Godown, The Bund Avenue Edward
VII and store same in the Dah An Godown at the corner of
Canton and Kiangse Roads. Whilst I and two coolies named
Ts Mo Sung and Kong Ts Sui were inside the alleyway where
the Dah An Godown is situated, 5 or 6 Inspectors of the
Consolidated Tax Bureau of Kiangsu, Chekiang and Anhwei
Provinces approached me and demanded an examination of the
tax certificate for the goods concerned. I then produced
the certificate issued by Ningpo Authorities, but they
stated that it was only valid for inland and insisted that
I should pay the tax again at Shanghai. I then informed
them that I would do so after the goods having been stored
in the godown and return to the shop. However, they
refused to comply with my request and taking possession of
the Ningpo tax certificate, brought me and the coolie Ts
Mo Sung to the 4th floor of the Tax Bureau, No.250 Kinkiang
Road where we were detained. The other coolie Kong Ts Sui
after storing the goods in the godown, returned to the shop
and reported the incident to the proprietor whereupon a
representative was immediately despatched to smooth over
the matter. The Inspectors then demanded a cash security
of $3,000 for our release as all the goods had already been
moved into the godown, otherwise we would be detained
pages.zh:
黄子芳（Wong Ts Fong），27岁，宁波人。

中央巡捕房 1939年11月17日。

我在法租界辣斐德路（Rue Laguerre）永安坊11号的赛泰烟叶行担任会计。1939年11月17日下午12点30分，店主指示我从位于外滩爱德华七世大道的泰昌仓库运送39包重约3,900斤的烟叶，并将其存入位于广东路与江西路转角的大安仓库。当我和两名名叫朱茂松及江子水的苦力在大安仓库所在的小巷内时，5或6名苏浙皖统税局的稽查员走近我，要求检查相关货物的完税证。我随即出示了由宁波当局签发的完税证，但他们声称该证仅在内陆有效，并坚持要求我在上海再次缴税。我随后告知他们，待货物存入仓库并返回店铺后我会办理缴税。然而，他们拒绝了我的请求，没收了宁波完税证，并将我和苦力朱茂松带至九江路250号统税局四楼，我们在那里被扣留。另一名苦力江子水将货物存入仓库后，返回店铺并向店主报告了此事，店主随即派出一名代表去调解此事。稽查员随后要求支付3,000美元现金保释金以释放我们，因为所有货物已搬入仓库，否则我们将被拘留

pages.en:

over-night and brought to Hongkew the next morning.
They ordered me to telephone to my proprietor requesting
him to settle the matter immediately lest we would not
get freedom. During our detention guards had been placed
to watch us, while the Inspectors returned to their homes.
At about 8.30p.m. whilst we were sitting there, police
officers arrived and brought us to the station.

Sir,

At 11 a.m. 10/11/1939, Interpreter Sheng Sui Yung (盛瑞生), attached to the Shanghai City Government Police Bureau, Jukong Road Station, visited the S.M.Police Traffic Office, and tendered an official dispatch from the Bureau, requesting assistance to arrest one named Mah Teh Yung (馬德榮), 27, Yangchow, a chauffeur, residing at Whashing Road, who was driving motor-truck S.M.C. License No. 20620 at the time the vehicle was involved in an accident at Pao An (宝安) Road, Chapei, in which a Japanese infant was knocked down and killed, on the 22/10/39. The Interpreter was referred to Yulin Road Station, which he visited at 4 p.m. 10/11/39.

When questioned, the Interpreter stated that he was not wanting assistance to visit Whashing Road, as detectives attached to the Bureau had already visited the chauffeur's home a few day's ago, and had definitely established that the man had absconded.

The Bureau is really seeking the assistance of the S.M. Police to arrest the chauffeur, Mah Tuh Yung, if he should at any time call at the Traffic Office to renew his Driving Permit, or for other purpose.

D.D.O. "D" Division.

先生，

1939年11月10日上午11时，隶属于上海市政府警察局菊恭路巡捕房的翻译盛瑞生（Sheng Sui Yung）访问了工部局警务处交通股，并提交了一份来自该局的公函，请求协助逮捕一名名叫马德荣（Mah Teh Yung）、27岁、扬州人、职业为司机、居住在华盛路（Whashing Road）的男子。该男子在1939年10月22日驾驶牌照号为20620的卡车在闸北宝安路发生事故，撞倒并致死一名日本幼儿。该翻译被指引至榆林路巡捕房，他于1939年11月10日下午4时到访。

经询问，该翻译表示并非需要协助前往华盛路，因为该局所属侦探已于数日前走访过该司机的住所，并确凿证实该人已潜逃。

该局实际上是寻求工部局警务处的协助，以便在司机马德荣（Mah Tuh Yung）任何时候前往交通股更新驾驶执照或因其他目的出现时将其逮捕。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. 3811/59.
Hongkew Station,
REPORT
Date November 8th, 1939.
Subject Report on Licences being issued by the Shanghai Special City Government
in Hongkew District.
Made By ____ and Forwarded by. Capt. Thos. A. Colfer,

Mr,

About 11.25 a.m. on November 6th, 1939 the
following telephone message was received from East
Hongkew Police Station:-

"The Shanghai Special City Government authorities
are issuing food shop licences at No. 609,
Boone Road, Hongkew District".

From enquiries made by Det. Secoroff and
Det. 33 Chang Lien Cheng it was learned that a Food
Shop is established at the address given and was opened
by one named Young Chi Yun (杨建生) on October 24th, 1939.
On November 3rd, 1939 he was approached by three male
Chinese who stated they were representatives of the
Shanghai Special City Government and it was necessary for
him to buy a licence from them to carry on his business.
He bought it for $6.00, and it gives him the privilege
to do business for one year. This licence it was learned
was taken away on the morning of November 6th, 1939 by
a member of the Revenue Department of the Shanghai
Municipal Council.

From further investigations made by the detec-
tives they discovered that a Food Shop at No. 529 Boone
Road, opened on October 16th, 1939 and owned by one
named Tang Yu Yun (唐遇云), had also bought a similar
licence on November 3rd, 1939 from two male Chinese and
paid $6.25 for it. The number of the licence seen by
the detectives is 343. Another Food Shop at No. 588 Boone

主题 关于上海特别市政府在虹口区颁发执照的报告。
由 ____ 制作并由托马斯·A·科尔弗上尉（Capt. Thos. A. Colfer）转发，

先生，

1939年11月6日上午11点25分左右，收到来自东虹口警察局的以下电话留言：-

“上海特别市政府当局正在虹口区博恩路（Boone Road）609号颁发食品店执照”。

经西科罗夫侦探（Det. Secoroff）和张连成侦探（Det. 33 Chang Lien Cheng）查询，获悉上述地址有一家食品店，由一名名叫杨建生（Young Chi Yun）的人于1939年10月24日开业。1939年11月3日，三名中国男子找到他，声称他们是上海特别市政府的代表，他必须从他们那里购买执照才能继续经营。他以6.00美元的价格购买了该执照，该执照赋予他一年的经营权。据悉，该执照于1939年11月6日上午被上海公共租界工部局捐务处的一名成员拿走。

通过侦探的进一步调查，他们发现博恩路529号有一家食品店，于1939年10月16日开业，业主为唐遇云（Tang Yu Yun），也于1939年11月3日从两名中国男子手中购买了类似的执照，并支付了6.25美元。侦探看到的执照号码是343。另一家位于博恩路588号的食品店

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Misc. File No. 189/39.
Yulin Road Station,
2nd REPORT
Date August 29th 1939.
Subject Arrest by Japanese Consular Police, at 216/8 Yenshan Road.
Made by D.S.I. Ross Forwarded by **〔此处转录不清〕**

Sir,
At 4.30 p.m. 24-8-1939, the arrested shopkeeper Ho Ching Hu was released from the J.C.G. Police Bureau Sub-Station, at Ching Kya Jeu, Chapci.
He was subsequently called to Yulin Road Station and requested to complete a written statement regarding his arrest and release. A translated copy of the statement is attached hereto.
It should be noted that Ho Ching Hu claims he was taken into custody by two uniformed constables of the J.C.G. Police Bureau, and another member of the same body in civilian clothing.
It is also noteworthy that he claims no Japanese subject was present at the time of his arrest or subsequently. He reiterated this statement verbally.
According to his assertion he had to pay the total sum of $42.00, to cover fines, tips and a banquet, through the agency of a loafer named Oong ( 苏 ) before being granted his freedom.

（批：C 30/8）
（批：21 Int 30/8）

I am, Sir,

J. Ross.

由罗斯副助理总监（D.S.I. Ross）制作 由 **〔此处转录不清〕** 转发

先生，
1939年8月24日下午4点30分，被捕店主何清湖（Ho Ching Hu）从闸北静嘉居（Ching Kya Jeu, Chapci，音译）的日本领事馆警察分局获释。
随后他被召至榆林路巡捕房，并要求就其被捕及获释一事完成书面陈述。陈述的译本附后。
值得注意的是，何清湖声称他是被两名身穿制服的日本领事馆警察局警员和另一名身穿便衣的该局成员拘捕的。
同样值得注意的是，他声称在他被捕时及之后，现场没有任何日本籍人士。他口头重申了这一说法。
据他声称，在获准释放之前，他必须通过一名名叫苏（Oong）的无业游民支付总计42.00美元，用于支付罚款、小费和宴请费用。

（批注：C 8月30日）
（批注：21 Int 8月30日）

先生，
您忠顺的仆人，
J. Ross。

Bob

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT OF POLICE INVESTIGATIONS.

The following is the statement of Zao Ching Jin, 42, M/shopmaster, 216 Yenshan Rd.
native of Tsingkiang taken by me C.D.S. 11
translated
at Y.R.Stn. on the 28-8-39 and interpreted by Clark Kiang.

In April this year, with the aid of my two friends named
Wei Chong Aung and Wong Ching Yuen, I started a candy shop at
216 Yenshan Road. We also sold beer - without a licence - as
sideline.

At about 9 a.m. on the 24-7-39, one named Ho Kuh Sung, the
master of the Yue Cheng Wine Shop, 215 Yenshan Road, accompanied
an unknown male Chinese to my shop and introduced him to me as
a salesman working for a Japanese beer company. He asked if I
wanted to buy beer through his agency, and I agreed to purchase
and received five cases of beer, at $10.80 per case.

At about 11 a.m. on the 23-8-39, two S.C.G.Police Constables
- wearing yellow uniform - and one Chinese plain clothes officer
came to my shop and inquired if I sold beer, to which I replied
in the affirmative. They then ordered that I produce all the
beer stored in my shop, and when I showed to them three of the
cases of the beer bought through the introduction of Ho Kuh Sung,
they secured me with handcuffs. I was then, together with the
beer found, conveyed to Shing Kya Jau S.C.G.P.B. sub-station, in
a motor truck.

I was questioned by the officer-on-duty of the sub-station
regarding the beer, and he told me that same had been stolen and
that I had committed the offence of Receiving Stolen Property. He
subsequently placed me in the cells.

After I was in prison, my assistant Mah Yuen Siang contact-
ed a well-known villager of Shing Kya Jau District, one named
Oeng, and requested the latter to settle the affair.

On the 24-8-39, Oeng told my assistant that I had been

今年四月，在我的两位朋友魏崇安（Wei Chong Aung）和王清元（Wong Ching Yuen）的帮助下，我在延森路216号开设了一家糖果店。我们也作为副业无证销售啤酒。

1939年7月24日上午9时许，延森路215号悦成酒坊的老板何谷松（Ho Kuh Sung）陪同一名身份不明的中国男子来到我的店里，并将他介绍为一家日本啤酒公司的推销员。他问我是否愿意通过他的代理购买啤酒，我同意购买，并收到了五箱啤酒，每箱价格为10.80美元。

1939年8月23日上午11时许，两名身穿黄色制服的华界巡捕和一名便衣中国警员来到我的店里，询问我是否出售啤酒，我给予了肯定回答。随后他们命令我交出店内储存的所有啤酒，当我向他们展示通过何谷松介绍购买的三箱啤酒时，他们用手铐将我铐住。随后，我与被查获的啤酒一起被一辆卡车押送至闸北邢家桥华界巡捕房分所。

Subject Arrest By Japanese Consular Police, at 216/8 Yenshan Road.

Sir,

At 5.50 p.m. 23-8-39, one shop assistant named Mah Yuen Siang (馬元驤) of the Lung Dah Chong (仁大昌) Grocery Shop, 216-8 Yenshan Road, reported at the station that at about 12 noon, even date, the manager of his shop named Zao Ching Hu (趙錦瑚) was arrested by two members of the S.C.G. Police Bureau for having received 5 cases of beer which had been stolen from a Japanese subject.

It was learned from Mah Yuen Siang that, on the 24-7-39, through the agency of a shroff named Hu Hwen Vung (胡煥文) the manager Zao Ching Hu purchased five cases of Japanese beer, at $10.50 per case. In the meantime two cases had been sold to customers, and the remaining three cases left in the shop.

At 12 noon 23-8-1939, two constables of the S.C.G. Police Bureau - in uniform - entered the shop. They detained Zao Ching Hu, accused him of receiving the beer, and stated same had been stolen from a Japanese subject. It was explained to the constables how the beer reached the store, and a reply was received that the shroff Hu Hwen Vung would have to be arrested before the manager could be released. When leaving the constables also carried away the three cases of beer, and mentioned that they were attached to the sub-station at Shing Kya Jau, Chapei.

At about 5.40 p.m. 23-8-1939, the above shop assistant Mah Yuen Siang succeeded in locating the shroff Hu Hwen Vung, at his home at No. 40 San Yih Li, Yangtsepoo Road, who accompanied him to this station for questioning.

报告
日期：1939年8月24日。

事由：在延森路216/8号被日本领事馆警察逮捕。

制作人：督察李义通（Lee Yee Tong）。转发人 [签名]

先生：

1939年8月23日下午5时50分，延森路216-8号仁大昌（Lung Dah Chong）杂货店的一名店员马元祥（馬元驤）到巡捕房报案称，同日中午12时许，该店经理赵锦瑚（趙錦瑚）因收受从一名日本臣民处盗窃的五箱啤酒，被两名华界巡捕房警员逮捕。

据马元祥称，1939年7月24日，经理赵锦瑚通过一名名为胡焕文（Hu Hwen Vung）的掮客，以每箱10.50美元的价格购买了五箱日本啤酒。其间两箱已售给顾客，剩余三箱留在店内。

1939年8月23日中午12时，两名身穿制服的华界巡捕房警员进入店内。他们拘留了赵锦瑚，指控他收受啤酒，并称这些啤酒是从一名日本臣民处盗窃的。有人向警员解释了啤酒是如何进入店内的，得到的答复是，在经理获释之前，必须先逮捕掮客胡焕文。离开时，警员还带走了这三箱啤酒，并提到他们隶属于闸北邢家桥分所。

1939年8月23日下午5时40分左右，上述店员马元祥成功在杨树浦路三益里40号的家中找到了掮客胡焕文，后者随他来到本巡捕房接受讯问。

Sir:
At 8.30 a.m. 15/8/39 a male Chinese named Ching
Pau Liang (秦宝良), owner of the Yue Shing (悦兴) Wine
Hong, 833 Lay Road, came to the station and reported that
at about 8 a.m. 15/8/39 one of his assistants named Tsang
Wha Kwei (张华桂) whilst on Lay Road near wayside road on
his way to deliver two jars of wine to the Hung Sung (洪松)
Wine Shop on S. Yuhang Road, he had been arrested and taken
away by two male Chinese because the "Wine Tax" had not
been paid. C.D.C. 348 and the undersigned attended the
scene and on arrival discovered that the assistant, Tsang
Wha Kwei, had already returned.
When questioned, the assistant stated that after
his arrest he was taken to Lay and Ward Roads corner
where one of his captors spoke in Japanese to a member
of the J.N.L. Party on duty at this corner. His captor
then told him to stand by the sentry and wait and after
this they left. The sentry detained him for about five
minutes and then motioned him away whereupon he returned
to 833 Lay Road taking the wine with him.
Ching Pau Liang has been instructed to notify the
station immediately should these men return.
The shop was previously visited by Tax Bureau officials
on 8-8-39 (See Report No. 1).

第二次报告    日期：1939年8月15日
事由：受江苏及浙江酒税局雇佣的中国人非法行使职权。
制作人：警佐怀特（White）    转发人〔此处转录不清〕

先生：
1939年8月15日上午8时30分，辣斐德路833号悦兴（Yue Shing）酒行的业主秦宝良（Ching Pau Liang）来到巡捕房报案称，1939年8月15日上午8时许，其一名名为张华桂（Tsang Wha Kwei）的助手在辣斐德路靠近路边处，正前往南余杭路的洪松（Hung Sung）酒行送两坛酒时，因未缴纳“酒税”而被两名中国男子逮捕并带走。中央侦探348号及本人赶赴现场，到达时发现助手张华桂已经返回。
经讯问，该助手陈述称，被捕后他被带到辣斐德路与华德路转角处，其中一名抓捕者用日语与该角落执勤的一名日本海军陆战队（J.N.L.）成员交谈。随后抓捕者让他站在哨兵旁边等待，之后他们便离开了。哨兵扣留了他约五分钟，然后示意他离开，于是他带着酒返回了辣斐德路833号。
已指示秦宝良，如果这些人再次出现，立即通知巡捕房。
该店此前曾于1939年8月8日受到税务局官员的走访（参见报告编号1）。

Sgt. in charge the following information was obtained:-
On the 18/7/39 they had received a report from one
Yang Sung Ling ( 楊 松 林 ) an employee of the American

firm he was employed by had been victimised by 8 armed
men who demanded from them $40.00 the City Government
Police acting on this information had told the informant
to arrange a meeting with these people on the 20/7/39,
which appointment these men kept, but they arrived
before the City Government Police, and after staying a
short time left without making any demands, on their
leaving the informant followed them and saw 3 of them
enter a small teashop on Great Western Road and start
to play Mah Jong whereupon the informant went to the
City Government Sub Station and imparted this information
which was acted upon by these Police and they raided the
said teashop, No. 1157 Great Western Road and placed the
3 men under arrest and took them to the sub-station
where they gave their particulars as follows:-
(1) Kyung Tack San ( 全 祝 三 ), 38, Kempo,
a/truck coolie, residing Rue Wanta, P.O.
(2) Chang Vung Chi ( 長 文 智 ), 36, Chinkiang,
unemployed, residing Rue Canty, P.O.
(3) Vong Kyung Sung ( 王 全 生 ), 38, Chinkiang,
unemployed, residing in a straw hut off
Tunsin Road.
After being questioned, they transferred these men

值班警长处获得了以下信息：
1939年7月18日，他们收到大西路369号美国改良公司（American Improvement Co.）雇员杨松林（楊松林）的报告，称其所在公司遭到8名武装男子的侵害，勒索40.00美元。市政府警察根据这一信息，告知举报人安排与这些人于1939年7月20日会面。这些人如期赴约，但他们比市政府警察早到，停留片刻后未提出任何要求便离开了。他们离开时，举报人跟随他们，看见其中三人进入大西路的一家小茶馆并开始打麻将。于是举报人前往市政府分局报告了这一情况，警方随即采取行动，突袭了位于大西路1157号的上述茶馆，逮捕了这三名男子，并将他们带到分局。他们提供的个人资料如下：
(1) 全祝三（Kyung Tack San），38岁，金波（Kempo，音译）籍，汽车苦力，住万塔路（Rue Wanta），邮政信箱。
(2) 长文智（Chang Vung Chi），36岁，镇江籍，无业，住坎蒂路（Rue Canty），邮政信箱。
(3) 王全生（Vong Kyung Sung），38岁，镇江籍，无业，住敦信路旁的一处草棚内。
经过讯问后，他们将这些人移交

乘坐福特出租车前往西摩路（Siccawei）分区警署。
中央巡捕房（C. P. C.）393号称，他看见在大西路（Great Western Road）实施逮捕，随后在1939年7月20日下午2时30分，看见3名被捕男子被放入一辆车牌号为12293的福特出租车，该车沿哥伦比亚路（Columbia Road）向南驶离。
警方试图在大西路寻找一家名为“美国改良公司”（American Improvement Co.）的商号，但未获成功；随后走访了369号，发现这是一家由赵纪生（Zau Kyi Sung）经营的竹器店，且该店主并未向市政府警察局提出任何投诉。随后走访了海格路（Avenue Haig）的福特出租车行，查明12293号车属于该车行，并于1939年7月20日下午2时30分被召至1173号。司机被找到，其名为艾堂生（Nai Baung Sung），执照号码为2253。经讯问，他陈述道：当他抵达1173号（他知道那是市政府警察局的一个分局）时，6名便衣男子进入车内，命令他驶往西摩路（Siccawei）。他遵照指示，沿以下路线行驶：哥伦比亚路、安赫斯特大道（Amherst Avenue）、罗克希尔大道（Rockhill Avenue）至海格路，最终到达目的地。他在上海学院（Shanghai College）附近停车，那六人下车，他便被解雇遣散。这些人在途中未进行任何交谈。

and at about 2p.m. today 3 of the extortionist again
visited the factory and the detective moved towards
them with the result that they decamped onto Great
Western Road and ran east towards Columbia Road, being
pursued by the detective and informant, as they passed
the Sub-Station the uniform members saw what was

Subject. Illegal Functioning of the Kiangsu, Chekiang and Anhwei Wine
Tax Bureau
Made by D.S.Coleman Forwarded by 〔此处转录不清〕
Sir:
At 11.45 a.m. 29/7/39 Woo Luh Tsang (〔此处转录不清〕)/shopmaster
of the Yue Tsang Ziang (〔此处转录不清〕) Wine Shop No. 212 Y nshan
Roa came to the station and reported that at 6 a.m.29/7/39
two representatives of the City Government Tax Bureau had
called at his hong and demanded that he register his shop
with above mentioned Bureau.
Enquiries made by C.D.S. 13 and the undersigned
ascertained the following:-
At 6 a.m. 29/7/39 two male Chinese in civilian clothes,
who gave their names as Sung(〔此处转录不清〕) and Lau(〔此处转录不清〕) respectively,
entered his hong and demanded that he register with the
Kiangsu, Chekiang and Anhwei Wine Tax Bureau.
These two men asked Woo to accompany them to the Tax
Bureau Offices on Chapoo Road for the purpose of registering.
This Woo refused to do stating that he had just recover-
ed from an illness and was not in a fit condition to attend
their offices, but promised to do so during the afternoon
of 31/7/39.
This met with the approval of the two representatives,
who left the hong without demanding any fee at all.
To date, Woo has not gone to the offices of the Bureau.
He has been informed that should any person purporting
to having come from the Bureau, again visit his hong, he
is to inform Yulin Road Station immediately.

日期：1939年7月29日
事由：江苏浙江安徽酒税局非法活动
呈报人：D.S. Coleman 转呈人：〔此处转录不清〕
先生：
1939年7月29日上午11时45分，银山路（Y nshan Roa，原文如此）212号“悦昌祥”（Yue Tsang Ziang，音译）酒行店主吴禄藏（Woo Luh Tsang，音译）〔此处转录不清〕来到警署报告称，1939年7月29日上午6时，两名市政府税务局代表到访他的商行，要求他向上述税务局登记注册。
经刑事侦缉处13号警探及本人调查，查明情况如下：
1939年7月29日上午6时，两名身穿便服的中国男子进入他的商行，自称分别为宋（Sung，音译）〔此处转录不清〕和刘（Lau，音译）〔此处转录不清〕，并要求他向江苏浙江安徽酒税局登记注册。
这两人要求吴陪同他们前往乍浦路（Chapoo Road）的税务局办公室办理注册手续。吴予以拒绝，称其刚刚病愈，身体状况不适合前往他们的办公室，但承诺将于1939年7月31日下午前去办理。
两名代表对此表示同意，未索取任何费用便离开了商行。
截至目前，吴尚未前往该局办公室。已告知吴，若有声称来自该局的人员再次造访其商行，应立即通知榆林路警署。

RECORD OF INVESTIGATION.
Functioning of constables of the Shanghai City Government Police Bureau outside the home of Mr. Loo Ying, at 326, Wuchow Road

Sir,

It has been observed that Mr. Loo Ying 盧英 , the Commissioner of the Shanghai City Government Police Bureau, has occasion to visit the house which he now occupies at 326, Wuchow Road, two constables are always take up a position on the footpath outside the entrance to the house, and remain there until his departure.

It would appear that the constables had been detailed for duty outside the house, but as no attempt has been made to engage them in conversation this point cannot be definitely established.

It is only within recent date that the constables have been observed outside the entrance, and it is not known if they previously took up a position inside the house.

When outside the entrance the constables wear the issue uniform of the Bureau, but do not carry arms.

On October 29th. 1938, a report was submitted by D.C.I. Moir to the effect that Mr. Loo Ying would reside in 326, Wuchow Road, which was occupied prior to the outbreak of the hostilities by a Mr. Ma Lai Young 馬蘭芳 a wealthy land-owner (Please see Misc. 78/38 K.Rd.).

Subject Illegal functioning of the Jiangsu & Chekiang Wine Tax Bureau.

Made by D.C. 24 White Forwarded by [Signature] Insp:-

Sir:
At 11.30 a.m. 10/6/39 C.I. Charrock (T. d) reported that whilst with S.M.C. Revenue Department employee collecting rates etc. on Lay Road he was informed by the owner of a wine hong No. 837 Lay Road that at 1 p.m. 8/6/39 a representative of the City Government Tax Bureau had called at his hong and demanded $10.00 for licence fee.

Inquiries made by C.D.C. 303 and the undersigned ascertained the following from Ching Pau Liang (詹寶良), owner of the Yue Shing Wine Hong, 837 Lay Road:-

At 1 p.m. 8/6/39 a male Chinese in civilian clothes entered the hong and after examining several casks and jars of wine contained therein he informed Ching that he was a representative of the Jiangsu and Chekiang Wine Tax Bureau, and that as the wine bore no tax stamp of the Bureau, he, Ching, would have to appear at the offices of the Bureau on Chapoo Road at 9 a.m. 9/6/39 and pay $10.00 to obtain a wine licence? Ching however pointed out to the representative that as his premises were situated within the limits of the Settlement it was therefore not necessary for him to obtain this licence. In reply to this the representative informed Ching that his premises were on Chinese territory therefore he was to appear at the offices of the Bureau, after this he left the hong.

To-date Ching has not gone to the office of the Bureau. He has been informed that should any person purporting to having come from the Bureau again visit his hong, he is to inform the station immediately.

呈报人：第24号巡官 White 转呈人：[签名] 督察:-

先生：
1939年6月10日上午11时30分，刑事侦缉员 Charrock（T. d）报告称，当他在雷路（Lay Road）与工部局捐务处雇员一起征收捐税等款项时，雷路837号一家酒行的店主告知他，1939年6月8日下午1时，市政府税务局的一名代表曾到访其酒行，索要10.00元执照费。

经第303号华探及本报告人调查，从雷路837号“悦盛”酒行（Yue Shing Wine Hong）店主詹寶良（Ching Pau Liang）处获悉以下情况：

1939年6月8日下午1时，一名身穿便服的中国男子进入该酒行，在检查了店内数个酒桶和酒坛后，告知詹氏，他是江苏浙江酒税局的代表，并称由于这些酒未贴该局税票，詹氏须于1939年6月9日上午9时前往乍浦路（Chapoo Road）该局办事处，缴纳10.00元以获取酒类执照？然而，詹氏向该代表指出，由于其经营场所位于租界范围内，因此无需领取此执照。对此，该代表回复詹氏称，其场所位于中国领土，因此他必须前往该局办事处，随后便离开了酒行。

截至目前，詹氏尚未前往该局办事处。已告知詹氏，若有自称来自该局的人员再次造访其酒行，须立即通知本警署。

REPORT
Date June 7th, 1939.

Subject Alleged Functioning of Armed Members of the S.C.G. Police on
Robison Road.

Made by D.S.I. Lachey Forwarded by Inspector i/c.

Sir,

With reference to a telephone message from Pootoo Road
station at 11.20 a.m. June 7, 1939, regarding the alleged
functioning of Shanghai City Government Police on Robison Road,
F.P.C. 149 R.G. Nocera, attached to Pootoo Road Station, was
questioned by the undersigned and the following ascertained.

F.P.S. Nocera i/c search party consisting of four C.P.C.s
was in vicinity of Singapore and Connaught Roads corner and
about fifty yards from the S.C.G. Police Bureau Sub-Station
where, at about 10 a.m. an Italian military patrol of six men
approached having in charge two uniformed members of the S.C.G.
Police, whom they had disarmed of mauser pistols, and one male
and one female Chinese.

The N.C.O. in charge requested F.P.S. Nocera to inter-
pret for him.

The two S.C.G. Policemen were questioned as to why they
were functioning on Robison Road. The questioned men explain-
ed that they had been called to a fight in O.O.L. territory off
Robison Road where they had arrested the male and female (the
latter bore some scratches on her face which bears out the
foregoing).

The Italian N.C.O. detained the foursome and telephoned
his billet. A few minutes later an officer, Lieut. Ferdinands
Contestabile, arrived and after further questioning satisfied
himself no functioning had wilfully occurred after which he
cautioned the two S.C.G. Policemen, returned their arms and
allowed them and their two arrests to proceed to the Bureau
Sub-Station nearby.

Yours obediently,
（签名）
D.S.I.

报告
日期：1939年6月7日。

事由：据称上海市政府警察武装人员在罗宾森路（Robison Road）行使职权。

呈报人：副督察长 Lachey 转呈人：主管督察。

先生，

关于1939年6月7日上午11时20分普陀路站打来的电话，涉及据称上海市政府警察在罗宾森路行使职权一事，附属于普陀路站的第149号外籍巡佐 R.G. Nocera 接受了本报告人的问询，查明情况如下。

负责搜查队的巡佐 Nocera 率领四名华捕，当时位于新加坡路（Singapore Road）与康纳特路（Connaught Road）转角附近，距离上海市政府警察局分局约五十码处。上午10时许，一支由六人组成的意大利军事巡逻队走近，押解着两名身穿制服的上海市政府警察人员（其毛瑟手枪已被缴械）以及一男一女两名中国人。

带队的意军士官请求巡佐 Nocera 为其翻译。

这两名上海市政府警察被问及为何在罗宾森路行使职权。受询人员解释说，他们是被召去处理罗宾森路外越界筑路区域（O.O.L. territory）的一起斗殴事件，并在当地逮捕了这一男一女（女子面部有抓痕，证实了上述说法）。

意军士官扣留了这四人，并打电话向其驻地汇报。几分钟后，一名军官 Ferdinands Contestabile 中尉抵达，经过进一步讯问，他确信并未发生故意越权行使职权的行为，随后他对两名上海市政府警察提出警告，归还了他们的武器，并允许他们带着两名被捕者前往附近的分局。

此致，
（签名）
副督察长。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

REPORT OF POLICE INVESTIGATIONS.

The following is the statement of Tang Aung Hyung,
native of Lotien taken by me
at W. Hongkew on the 9-5-39 and interpreted by Clerk Fu.

My name is Tang Aung Hyung, age 25, native of Lotien,
I am employed as a workman in a button factory and I reside
at 3 Co Poh Hong, North Soochow Road.
During the mid-day break at 12.30 p.m. 8-5-39, together
with fourteen or fifteen of my fellow employees, I was
standing about the entrance of the Chinese Chamber of Commerce.
A policeman, wearing a yellow uniform, ordered us to go
away whereupon one of my work-mates described the policeman
as a "Yellow hat".
They abused each other and suddenly a male Chinese,
dressed in plain clothes, approached from behind, caught
hold of me and pushed me into the Chamber of Commerce.
My hands were tied behind my back and I was slapped on
the face but I was not injured.
I was informed that I was to be taken before a Court
Martial and that I would be executed.
After being detained until 12.30 p.m. 9-5-39 I was
released on shop guarantee being furnished by my foreman,
Yong Soo Kung.

SD: Tang Aung Hyung.

双方互相辱骂，突然一名身穿便服的中国男子从背后走近，抓住我并将我推进商会内。

1.

布伦南坊（Brennan Place）工部局警务处与上海市政府警察局之间的冲突。

1939年5月7日晚上8时，第1210号华捕通过6号街面电话报告称，布伦南坊即将爆发华捕与上海市政府警察局武装人员之间的斗殴。警署警报响起，在 "B" 区助理警务处长 Shellswell 警司和 Dudley 督察指挥下的所有可用警力出动。抵达布伦南坊时，并未发生打斗，但发现两名持有军用毛瑟自动手枪的上海市政府警察局侦探，以及一名持有装有枪托的同类武器的该局制服人员，正与下列警员争论：第1143号巡佐和第2274号华捕（分区巡逻）；第1604号巡佐，第1225、1226、1228及1261号华捕（布伦南坊巡逻）；第461及1210号华捕（布伦南坊6号电话亭）；以及第86号华捕（罗宾森路与约瑟菲尔德路交界处的24号交通岗）。

经查询得知，1939年5月7日晚上7时50分左右，三名上海市政府警察局侦探和一名制服巡捕，均如前所述持有毛瑟手枪，被看到在约瑟菲尔德路（Josefield Road）上从罗宾森路向布伦南坊工部局6号电话亭方向巡逻。第1143号巡佐告诉这群人限制

its armed patrolling to Chinese Territory. The party
refused to leave the road because they had been
instructed to keep observation on the crowd outside
the Orpheum (Tien Loh 天樂) Theatre on the corner
of Robison and Jessfield Roads, as information had been
received that somebody was expected to throw a bomb in
that area.

As neither side was willing to give way and the
situation appeared to be getting tense, C.P.C. 1210
telephoned Bubbling Well Station. (As in paragraph No.1).

After a short discussion between Supt. Shellswell
and Insp. Dudley and the S.C.G.P. Bureau patrol, the
last named agreed to keep to the pavement near the
Orpheum Theatre.

At the above time only two S.C.G.P.B. detectives
were present. Later, after the withdrawal of the
Station alarm party and the following incident it is
reasonably assumed that he reported the incident to the
Japanese Gendarmerie at 94 Jessfield Road.

At 8.35p.m. 7/8/39 C.P.C. 68 reported by Street
Telephone No. 6 that Japanese Gendarmerie were trying
to arrest C.P.C. 1210. A small party under Supt.
Shellswell and Insp. Dudley proceeded to Brenan Place
and found that the Gendarmerie had left.

杂项档案第 257/39 号。

1/2.

其武装巡逻进入中国地界。该队拒绝离开道路，因为他们奉命在罗宾逊路（Robison Road）与极司菲尔路（Jessfield Road）转角处的天乐大戏院（Orpheum Theatre，即天乐）外监视人群，此前收到情报称有人预计在该区域投掷炸弹。

由于双方均不愿让步，且局势似乎日趋紧张，华捕巡长 1210 号致电静安寺捕房。（如第 1 段所述）。

经过谢尔斯韦尔警司（Supt. Shellswell）、达德利督察（Insp. Dudley）与上海市警察局（S.C.G.P. Bureau）巡逻队之间的简短商讨，后者同意留在天乐大戏院附近的人行道上。

在上述时间，仅有两名上海市警察局便衣侦探在场。后来，在捕房出警小队撤离及随后发生的事件之后，可以合理推断，他向极司菲尔路 94 号的日本宪兵队报告了此事。

1939 年 8 月 7 日晚上 8 点 35 分，华捕巡长 68 号通过 6 号街用电话报告，日本宪兵队正试图逮捕华捕巡长 1210 号。由谢尔斯韦尔警司和达德利督察率领的一小队在布伦南里（Brenan Place）发现宪兵队已经离开。

1/3.

It was then learned that at about 8.20p.m. 7/5/39
a van containing about twenty armed S.C.O.P. Bureau
uniformed men, two uniformed Japanese Gendarmes and one
plainclothes Japanese, went to Brenan Piece. The
Japanese and the majority of their men stood around and
did nothing while one of the plain-clothes S.C.G.P.B.
detectives put his Mauser pistol at C.P.C. 1210's head,
seized him by his tunic at the neck and called him,
among other things, "A thirteen country traitor
( 十三国奸细 )" (i.e. in the employ of the S.M.C.).
One of the uniformed S.C.G.P. Bureau men struck C.P.C.
1210 lightly on the left shoulder with his rifle. Until
about 8.35p.m. when the party was about to leave, the
S.M.P. Chinese were not allowed to telephone the
station.

（批：B.P.C 1210 was withdrawn from Well Station, the situation on Brenan Piece was returning to normal. At the time of our 2nd visit）

When the second S.M.P. party returned to Bubbling
Well Station, the situation on Brenan Piece was return-
ing to normal.

Statements have been taken from C.P.S. 1143 and
C.P.C. 1210, and are attached.

Copy for:- D.C. (Divs.).

随后获悉，1939 年 5 月 7 日晚上 8 点 20 分左右，一辆面包车装载着约二十名身穿制服的武装上海市警察局人员、两名身穿制服的日本宪兵和一名便衣日本人，前往布伦南里（原文误作 Brenan Piece）。日本人及其大部分手下站在周围无所事事，而一名上海市警察局便衣侦探将他的毛瑟手枪顶在华捕巡长 1210 号的头上，抓住他颈部的上衣领口，并称他为“十三国奸细”（意指受雇于工部局）等。一名身穿制服的上海市警察局人员用步枪枪托轻击华捕巡长 1210 号的左肩。直到晚上 8 点 35 分左右该队准备离开时，工部局警务处的华籍警员才被允许打电话回捕房。

（批注：华捕巡长 1210 号已从静安寺捕房撤回，布伦南里的局势正在恢复正常。在我们第二次到访时）

当第二支工部局警务处小队返回静安寺捕房时，布伦南里的局势正在恢复正常。

已对华捕探员 1143 号和华捕巡长 1210 号取得供词，附后。

C.P.S./(YH) Loh Tsing Sai
Relying xx Inspr. Yao Kya Kwei
B'Well 7/5/39 Inspr. Yao Kya Kwei .

On the night of the 6/5/39 whilst on duty on North Section
I overheard that a uniformed S.C.O. Police had stopped a ricksha
on Jessfield Road near telephone box and tried to induce the
female passenger to wait for him till he went off duty and then
he would escort her home. The female passenger was known to
have lost her way home and could not give the exact address.
One of our police men (number unknown) had disclosed the vitious
ideas of the S.C.O. Police and warned him to keep away from the
woman and mind his own business.

At 7.50p.m. on the 7/5/39 I was on North Section together
with C.P.C.2274 and arrived at Brenan Place to sign C.P.C.'s
conference books. C.P.C.1210 on duty at the Telephone Box
reported to me that 3 plain clothes men and one uniformed S.C.(
Police were found patrolling on Jessfield Road near Robison Roa
with pistols in their hands. So I approached them and spoke t
them in an undertone that it would be very nice of them to
leave the Municipal Road if they would perform their duty. They
refused to take my warning saying that it had nothing to do wi
me and continued their patrol.

I did not use any harsh word nor any sign of violence.
The said S.C.O. Police did not point any pistol at me but it w
apparent that they were firm in their intention to remain on
Municipal Road despite my verbal warning. Without my knowledge
one of the C.P.C.s telephoned to the Station and a party of
Police arrived under Inspr. Dudley.

The S.C.O. Police were then again warned to leave the
Municipal Road by Insp. Dudley after which they went into the
pages.zh:
1143
华捕探员/(YH) 罗清赛 (Loh Tsing Sai)
回复 xx 姚家贵督察 (Yao Kya Kwei)
静安寺 1939 年 5 月 7 日 姚家贵督察。

1939 年 5 月 6 日晚，我在北区执勤时，无意中听到一名身穿制服的上海市警察局警察在极司菲尔路电话亭附近拦下一辆人力车，并试图诱使女乘客等他下班，然后护送她回家。据悉该女乘客迷路，无法提供确切地址。我们的一名警员（编号不详）揭露了这名上海市警察局警察的邪恶念头，警告他远离该女子并管好自己的事。

1939 年 5 月 7 日晚上 7 点 50 分，我与华捕巡长 2274 号一起在北区执勤，到达布伦南里签署华捕巡长的会议记录簿。在电话亭执勤的华捕巡长 1210 号向我报告，发现有 3 名便衣男子和 1 名身穿制服的上海市警察局警察手持手枪在罗宾逊路附近的极司菲尔路上巡逻。于是我走近他们，低声对他们说，如果他们要执行公务，最好离开公共租界道路。他们拒绝接受我的警告，称这与我无关，并继续巡逻。

我没有使用任何粗鲁言语或暴力迹象。上述上海市警察局警察并未将手枪指向我，但显然他们不顾我的口头警告，坚决意图留在公共租界道路上。在我不知情的情况下，一名华捕巡长打电话回捕房，一支由达德利督察率领的警察队伍赶到。

随后，达德利督察再次警告上海市警察局警察离开公共租界道路，此后他们进入了

pages.en:
C.P.S. 1143.

Tien Loh Theatre on Jessfield Road and Robison Roads corner.
I continued my tour of duty at the same time as Inspr. Dudley
had settled the affair and left for the Station.
My idea of the incident is that this case is a
repercussion of the aforementioned female affair.

Signed by C.P.S. 1143.

华捕探员 1143 号。

位于极司菲尔路与罗宾逊路转角处的天乐大戏院。
与此同时，达德利督察已处理完此事并返回捕房，我继续我的巡逻任务。
我对该事件的看法是，此案是前述女子事件的余波。

华捕探员 1143 号签名。

C.P.C. 1210 (Pootoo Road) Sung Bei Hwa
Shantung xx Inspr. Yao Kya Kwei
B'well 7/5/39 Inspr. Yao Kya Kwei.

I have been temporarily transferred from Pootoo Road to
B'Well Station since 1/5/39 and detailed for duty at the Police
Telephone Box at Brenan Piece for the last six days.
At about 7.55p.m. 7/5/39 as I was on duty at the said
Telephone Box with C.P.C.461 (Pootoo Rd) I observed 3 plain
clothes' men and one uniform S.C.G. Police all with pistols in
their hands patrolling along Jessfield Road near Robison Road.
In the meantime C.P.S.1143 accompanied by C.P.C.2274 arrived to
sign our conference books and the said C.P.S. was informed of
the above patrol by S.C.G. Police on Municipal Road. Then
C.P.S. 1143 approached them and explained that they should not
function on the Municipal Road and it would be very nice of them
to do their duty inside the Chinese territory. Apparently the
S.C.G. Police officers did not quite agree to our Sergeant's
advice and so I went to the Telephone Box to inform the Station.
Immediately afterwards a party of B'well Police under the charge
of Inspr. Dudley arrived on the scene and the S.C.G. Police were
again advised to leave the Municipal Road. Accordingly they
went to the Tien Leh Theatre on corner of Jessfield and Robison
Roads. Soon after Inspr. Dudley left the scene at about 8.28
p.m. a party of S.C.G. Police consisting of about 20 uniformed
officers 5 or 6 plain clothes men (including one Japanese) and
two Japanese gendarmes conveyed to the spot in a M/Van. I was
then pointed out by one of the plain clothes men accusing me as
the chief offender and pistols were pointed at me on my head,
my shoulder was tabbed with rifle end, belt pulled and I was
also called as the 13 countries' traitor (meaning a traitor of
the International Settlement).
pages.zh:
华捕巡长 1210 号（普陀路）宋北华 (Sung Bei Hwa)
山东 xx 姚家贵督察
静安寺 1939 年 5 月 7 日 姚家贵督察。

自 1939 年 5 月 1 日起，我从普陀路临时调至静安寺捕房，并在过去六天内被派往布伦南里（原文误作 Brenan Piece）的警察电话亭执勤。
1939 年 5 月 7 日晚上 7 点 55 分左右，当我与华捕巡长 461 号（普陀路）在上述电话亭执勤时，我观察到 3 名便衣男子和 1 名身穿制服的上海市警察局警察手持手枪，沿着罗宾逊路附近的极司菲尔路巡逻。
与此同时，华捕探员 1143 号在华捕巡长 2274 号的陪同下前来签署我们的会议记录簿，华捕探员得知上述上海市警察局警察在公共租界道路上巡逻的情况。随后，华捕探员 1143 号走近他们，解释说他们不应在公共租界道路上执行公务，若能在中国地界内履行职责会更好。显然，上海市警察局警官不太同意我们巡长的建议，于是我去电话亭通知捕房。
紧接着，由达德利督察率领的一支静安寺捕房警察队伍赶到现场，并再次劝告上海市警察局警察离开公共租界道路。 accordingly 他们前往极司菲尔路与罗宾逊路转角处的天乐大戏院（原文拼写为 Tien Leh）。
不久后，达德利督察于晚上 8 点 28 分左右离开现场，一支由约 20 名穿制服警官、5 或 6 名便衣人员（包括一名日本人）和两名日本宪兵组成的上海市警察局队伍乘坐一辆机动面包车抵达现场。随后，一名便衣男子指认我为主要肇事者，用手枪指着我的头，用步枪枪托戳我的肩膀，拉扯我的腰带，并称我为“十三国奸细”（意指国际公共租界的叛徒）。

pages.en:
C.P.C. 1210.

I did not retaliate but submitted to humiliation at their
hearts content. I tried to communicate with the Station but
prevented by the .C.G. Police when I reached for the phone in
the telephone box. They stayed for about 10 minutes so even-
tually C.P.C. 58 phoned to the Station at 8.35p.m. when they
were about to leave. On the arrival of Inspr. Dudley and
party for the second time the .C.G. Police had already disapp-
eared.

I came back to the Station with Inspr. Dudley and made
this statement. In the Station I discovered one of my buttons
had been pulled off and lost presumably it was lost during the
manhandling.

Signed by C.P.C.1210.
pages.zh:
华捕巡长 1210 号。

我没有反击，而是任由他们羞辱。我试图与捕房联系，但当我伸手去拿电话亭里的电话时，被上海市警察局警察阻止。他们停留了约 10 分钟，因此最终在华捕巡长 58 号于晚上 8 点 35 分他们准备离开时打电话回捕房。当达德利督察及其队伍第二次到达时，上海市警察局警察已经消失。

我随达德利督察回到捕房并作了此陈述。在捕房里，我发现我的一颗纽扣被扯掉丢失，推测是在遭受粗暴对待时丢失的。

华捕巡长 1210 号签名。

先生，

关于 1939 年 4 月 22 日情报报告（晨译版）中摘录的《申报》标题为“上海市政府在虹口强行出售印花税票”的内容，经查询查明，1939 年 4 月 24 日上午，一名约 22 岁的中国男子，身高 5 英尺 7 英寸，长脸，面色蜡黄，长发向后梳，身穿深棕色西式西装，讲上海话，自称是受雇于江苏、浙江、安徽税务局的收税员，向下列杨树浦区的商店出售了一些印花税票。

1939.

Subject (in full) Functioning of "Reformed Government Chinese Soldiers" in
Wayside District.

Made by D.S.I. McCahey. Forwarded by [Signature] Officer i/c. [Signature]

Sir,

I beg to report that as inoculation of Chinese against
"Cholera" is now in full operation at the Japanese Special
Service Section Office at 213 Yangtszepoo Road, it has been
observed that at least four "Reformed Government Chinese Soldiers"
armed with rifles, bayonets, belts and ammunition pouches and
dressed in greenish khaki uniforms, under a Japanese N.C.O.
are functioning on that corner of Yangtszepoo and MacGregor
Roads where No. 213 is situated. The duties of these men
appear to be the marshalling of the two to three hundred Chinese
civilians(male and female)awaiting their turn for injection.

Your obedient servant,
[Signature]
D. S. I.

D.D.O."D".
D.C.(Special Branch).
